Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 1000+ employees, 8 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publishers worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Team

Our Growth team is a transversal entity aiming to maximize and deliver the potential of any mobile product. It combines user acquisition, creative content production, monetization, and the tech capabilities required to turn applications into global hits. You will be responsible for crafting visually compelling, gameplay-driven 3D ad creatives using Unreal Engine. From concept to final render, you'll have full ownership of the production pipeline.

- Create eye-catching 3D mobile ad creatives that clearly communicate gameplay and drive performance

- Build and animate complete scenes in Unreal Engine: characters, environments, VFX, lighting

- Apply storytelling and visual clarity to highlight core gameplay loops within 20–30 second formats

- Collaborate with Creative and UA teams to test, learn, and iterate quickly

Profile

- Strong generalist skills in Unreal Engine: modeling, texturing, lighting, animation, and rendering

- Proficient in Blueprint scripting and familiar with coding (C++ or similar) for scene logic and behavior

- Proficient with After Effects

- Strong user of AI pipelines

- Strong background creating performance marketing ads in Unreal Engine

- Understanding of mobile ad performance metrics like CTR, CPI, and ROAS

- Comfortable working with optimized assets and keeping performance constraints in mind

- Experience with Blender, Maya and animation tools are nice to have

title: Data Director, Growth and Marketing

description_md:
**🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.**

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍 London, Cardiff or UK Remote | 💰 £150,900 to £204,100 + stock options & benefits | ✅ Visa sponsorship & relocation available

**About our Data Discipline **

We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. Data is central to how we understand our customers, shape our products, manage risk and grow Monzo sustainably. We believe in empowering teams with high-quality, trusted data and self-serve analytics, while creating space for Data practitioners to focus on the highest-impact questions, opportunities and decisions.

Our Data Discipline is deeply embedded in Monzo’s product areas. Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, and Machine Learning Engineers work in cross-functional squads alongside Engineers, Designers, Product Managers and other disciplines. This means Data is not a downstream service, and instead we shape strategy, challenge thinking, build the data foundations teams need to move quickly, and share accountability for customer and commercial outcomes.

**Our Growth and Marketing Analytics team  ⭐**

We’re looking for a Data Director to join our Growth and Marketing Collective here at Monzo. Our goal in Growth and Marketing is to build Monzo into a global brand people love. We're the team that finds exciting new ways to bring customers to Monzo and keep them engaged once they join. We create the features and cool stuff that gets everyone talking about us. We also figure out the best ways to communicate with our customers. Data is a driving force in everything we do, and this role will lead the team making sure our Growth and Marketing folks can easily use data to inform their every day decisions.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...

On day one, you'll develop and nurture a diverse data team to make smart marketing and product driven growth investments. You’ll work closely with the Growth and Marketing collective leadership team to set the overall direction and work with your team to craft the insights, data products, and intelligent systems to realise those ambitions. You’ll help us with the following questions and challenges:

- Define our global marketing strategy as well as our product growth one

- How to balance growing different markets and customer segments

- Advance our measurement precisions to grow our confidence in where to best invest next

- Balancing marketing with product driven growth

- Deeply understand network effects and the role they play

**🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…**

- You’re excited about what we’re doing at Monzo and have experience leading Data teams at Director level or above.

- You’re an empathetic, inclusive leader who has hired, developed and retained high-performing Data teams, including individual contributors and managers.

- You have a hands-on Data Science background and can move comfortably between technical detail, commercial outcomes and customer strategy.

- You have deep experience in marketing measurement, experimentation and choosing the right methods to guide investment and growth decisions.

- You’ve led goal-setting across a company or division, defining clear metrics and targets in partnership with Finance.

- You can turn complex business challenges into technical solutions and clear, actionable recommendations.

- You build strong relationships across business areas and are comfortable influencing senior stakeholders, including ExCo and C-level leaders.

- You’re comfortable with ambiguity and use data to challenge thinking, navigate trade-offs and improve how teams make decisions

**🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps**

- 30 minute recruiter call

- 60 minute call with the hiring manager

- 4 x 1-hour video calls with various team members, including the General Manager for Growth & Marketing

Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability.

**🙌 What’s in it for you...**

💰 £150,900 to £204,100 ➕ plus stock options & benefits

✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK/Spain

✅ We can sponsor visas

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

📚 Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

#LI-JH1  #LI-Remote

**Equal opportunities for everyone**

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

title: AI Creative Producer

company.name: Homa
company.blurb: Mobile games publisher (hyper/hybrid-casual).

description_md:
**Homa** is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor. Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.

At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

**The opportunity**

At Homa, AI is already part of how we make ads, playables and 3D assets. Now we need someone to turn it into a system that moves business results: faster wins, lower CPI (cost per install) and lower cost per winning ad.

You'll join our Creatives team and report to our Head of Creatives. You'll own the full cycle, from idea and brief to finished ad, and you'll work closely with UA, data and creative leads. You'll have access to the best AI models and tools from day one.

Contract setup: This is a full-time opportunity. The contractual arrangement will be B2B/freelance only.

**Your responsibilities**

- **Map.** Map our creative cycle (insights, production, testing, learnings) and find where AI saves the most time or lifts performance.
- **Build.** Build and own end-to-end AI pipelines and automations, from hypothesis to tool choice to rollout in the team.
- **Produce.** Come up with ideas, write briefs, and produce AI creatives yourself (video, playables, 3D), turning ideas into ads that win.
- **Raise.** Set the quality bar for the team, and push AI output until it's on-brand and stops the scroll.
- **Measure.** Choose what to automate with UA, data and creative leads, then measure the impact on speed, cost and performance.
- **Scout.** Keep testing new AI models and tools like Veo, Sora, Kling and Runway, and turn the useful ones into team workflows.
- **Scale.** Design workflows that scale across games, and train the team so they can use them without you.

**RequirementsWhat we look for**

- **Ownership.** You drive outcomes. When something breaks, you fix it instead of explaining why it broke.
- **Proactive.** You don't wait for instructions or perfect conditions. You spot what needs doing and do it.
- **Pragmatism.** You look for the simplest solution that works, use whatever tools are available, and ship.
- **Sharp thinking.** You learn fast, reason from facts, and structure your ideas clearly.
- **AI-driven.** AI is already part of how you work every day. You've used it to automate, speed up, or rethink.
- **Motivated.** You're ambitious and grounded. You see this opportunity as a chance to learn faster than anywhere else.

**For this role, you'll also bring**

- 3+ years in motion or video design, ideally on ads, with a portfolio that includes AI-made work.
- Visual taste. You can tell a good ad from a generic one, and you finish AI output by hand when it needs it.
- Hands-on AI video skills, plus strong After Effects or similar motion tools.
- A gaming background. You know mobile games, ideally hybrid-casual or casual, and what makes players tap.
- Critical and marketing thinking. You think in hooks, audiences and performance data, not just assets.
- Systems and automation expertise. You don't just make AI creatives, you design workflows that scale across games.
- Full autonomy. You spot problems, decide, ship and report without being managed day to day.

**Bonus points if you have:**

- UA or performance creative experience, ideally with winning ads on networks like AppLovin.
- Hands-on experience with Blender or other 3D tools, Unity, or playable ad tools.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

**BenefitsWhy Homa**

- **Exceptional growth.** We hire people of outstanding potential, then put them where they can grow fastest. Your scope and your rewards grow with what you deliver, not with tenure.
- **Real ownership.** No layers between you and the result. You own outcomes, not tasks, whatever your level.
- **Direct impact.** Your work moves the business and shapes where Homa goes next. Decisions are made fast, and you see the results in the numbers.
- **AI at the core.** With access to the best AI tools, you'll help shape how an AI-first company works, and your time goes where your judgment matters most.
- **High talent bar.** Our teams are small with people from the best companies, and the talent around you will push you to grow.

**What we offer**

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here's what you can expect:

- **Comprehensive benefits.** Depending on where you're based, you'll get perks such as health insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym membership, and more.
- **A brand-new Paris HQ.** A desk in our new office in the heart of Paris, whenever you want to work side by side with the team.
- **An international team.** Work in English with top talent from 35+ countries across Europe, the UK, the US, and beyond. Our diversity fuels our creativity.
- **Team gatherings.** We value time together beyond the screen. Join regular team gatherings and off-site retreats to connect, recharge, and celebrate.
- **Performance reviews.** Every six months, we look back at your progress, recognise your wins, and agree on clear goals for what's next.
- **Equipment support.** From day one, you get everything you need to do your best work, including a home office allowance if you work remotely.

**Where we hire**

Our Paris HQ is a lively hub for creativity, collaboration, and connection. From lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, it's a space people genuinely enjoy, in our brand-new office in the heart of Paris (awesome energy and snacks included).

We also have great teammates across Europe, from Spain and Turkey to Germany, North Macedonia, Poland, the UK, and more. Whether you work from home in Barcelona or Warsaw, you're fully part of our culture. To keep collaboration smooth, we mainly hire within European time zones (UTC to UTC+3). If you're based there, or planning to be, we'd love to hear from you!

Meta (app and web-to-app), AppLovin, plus evaluation and launch of new networks and DSPs. Decide what to scale, what to test and what to stop.• Own the web-to-app engine. Web funnels, paywalls, the CTA-to-store handoff, deep linking and attribution between web and app. Work with the funnel partner and product on pricing, offers and funnel experiments, judged on revenue per user, not step conversion alone.• Own measurement integrity. Keep AppsFlyer, the web funnel, ad networks and BI reconciled. Know which source is truth for which decision.• Forecast and report. Cohort LTV and ROAS curves, D7-to-D30/D60 projections, channel P&L and contribution margin. Present results and the plan to the team.• Lead the creative feedback loop. Turn new episodes and series into UA creative with the creative and content teams: hooks, cliffhanger cuts, recaps, UGC, playables, AI-produced variants. Design the testing system (budgets, thresholds, decision rules) so winners are picked on revenue quality, not CTR.• Partner with product and content. Feed UA learnings into onboarding, pricing and which series get promoted. Bring product and content insight back into targeting and creative.• Manage partners. Own relationships with network account managers, agencies and vendors. Negotiate tests, credits and terms, and hold partners accountable on performance.• Push AI and automation. Build and adopt AI workflows for reporting, anomaly detection, creative production, research and campaign operations. Treat manual repetition as a bug.• Track the category. Know what competitors are doing on channels, creative, pricing and markets, before it becomes obvious.**What you'll bring

**• 5+ years of hands-on UA or performance marketing in mobile apps, with personal ownership of a six-figure monthly budget across several channels.• Deep expertise on Paid Social and SDK Networks.• Strong measurement depth: AppsFlyer (or Adjust / Singular), SKAN / AdAttributionKit, privacy constraints, and when to use incrementality testing instead of attribution.• Analytical rigour: cohort analysis, LTV modelling and forecasting, and the habit of decomposing a metric before acting on it.• Creative judgement: you can write a brief that a creative team can execute, read a creative test correctly, and explain why an asset works.• Ownership and stakeholder skills: you present plans and bad news to leadership clearly, and you make decisions without waiting for a perfect dataset.• Active, daily use of AI tools, with at least one workflow you built yourself.• Fluent English.**Nice to have

**• Experience with subscription / IAP hybrid monetisation models, paywall optimisation, or content-driven LTV curves.• Solid understanding of web and web-to-app funnels ,  landing pages, conversion tracking, attribution between web and mobile, and how to optimize the handoff.• Exposure to vertical video, short-form content, or DTC entertainment apps.• Familiarity with influencer / creator-led UA, UGC creative pipelines, or AI creative tooling.• A track record running a 0→1 launch end-to-end ,  go-to-market plan, funnel build, channel mix, geo strategy, KPI/benchmark setting and scale-up post-launch.**What we offer

**• A live product, a real budget, and the mandate to shape how UA works at ReelSaga.• Direct collaboration with the product, content and creative teams that ship the actual show, not just the marketing surface.• Additional financial benefits based on annual success, such as a Christmas bonus, Easter bonus, summer bonus, 13th salary, referral bonuses and covered transportation expenses.• Work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model, with office days Tuesday to Thursday, an hour-long lunch break and 24 days of annual leave.• Multisport membership, a free annual health check-up, snacks, free lunch on office days and occasional discounts on services and products.• Kindergarten compensation and a baby bonus for new parents.
**

title: Senior 2D Marketing Artist

company.name: Scopely
company.blurb: Global mobile games company behind Monopoly GO!, Stumble Guys and MARVEL Strike Force.

description_md:
Scopely is looking for a **Senior 2D Marketing Artist** to join our **MONOPOLY GO!** team in Barcelona on a hybrid basis.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

**MONOPOLY GO!** is a global phenomenon and the biggest mobile game launch in history, captivating millions of players worldwide. The team is based in Europe and the US and works daily to create captivating new experiences for our players.

In this role, you’ll use illustration, composition, typography and design to connect MONOPOLY GO! with players across marketing and community channels. You’ll bring ideas from concept to final delivery, combining strong craft with rapid iteration and repeatable AI-assisted workflows that improve quality, consistency and efficiency.

**What You Will Do**

- Deliver high-quality 2D concepts and production art that reflect MONOPOLY GO!’s established style across social posts, Discord content, email headers, push assets, challenges, infographics and event communications

- Adapt existing art, including characters, stickers, pop-ups and backgrounds, into multiple formats while maintaining strong composition, visual hierarchy and readability

- Develop, document and share repeatable workflows using templates, AI-assisted processes and practical automation, evaluating emerging tools against real production needs

- Research and apply visual references to develop ideas for ambiguous or open-ended briefs and identify opportunities to improve the 2D production pipeline

- Create original lettering and logos for campaigns, events and community initiatives

- Own work from brief to final delivery by clarifying requirements, estimating scope, managing priorities and flagging risks early

- Give clear, specific and actionable feedback to internal and outsourced artists, using references or annotations to maintain the expected style and quality

- Partner with Art Production, Producers, Marketing and other teams to align briefs, priorities and deadlines, ensuring creative work supports campaign goals and business objectives

**What We’re Looking For**

- 6+ years of experience as a 2D or concept artist in games or games marketing, including 2+ years in a senior-level capacity

- Experience developing and applying repeatable AI-assisted workflows in production, with the judgment to evaluate where they improve quality, consistency or efficiency

- A track record of delivering high-quality 2D work on schedule while collaborating with Design, Engineering and outsourcing partners

- Advanced illustration and concept development skills, with a strong command of composition, form, color, typography and visual storytelling

- Advanced proficiency in Photoshop and the ability to research, synthesize and apply visual references to develop compelling creative ideas

- Experience designing logos and lettering for campaigns, events and player-facing initiatives, maintaining a consistent visual identity across channels

- Ability to communicate clearly with non-art stakeholders, clarify or challenge unclear briefs, negotiate priorities, and give and apply constructive feedback

**Bonus Points**

- Experience working within the brand guidelines and approval processes of an externally licensed IP

- Experience helping outsourcing partners meet established quality standards

- Strong 3D modeling skills in Maya, Blender or equivalent tools to support AI-assisted concept-to-3D workflows

- Experience in a creative studio, production company or advertising environment

Please include a portfolio or PDF/links to examples of your work in the application.

title: Growth Marketing Sr. Associate, New Channels

company.name: Acorns
company.blurb: Investing and saving app for everyday people.

description_md:
At Acorns, our mission is to look after the financial best interests of the up-and-coming, beginning with the empowering, proud step of micro-investing. How do we accomplish our mission? Our values.

**Lead With Heart** - With compassion, integrity, and tenacity, inspire yourself and others to move past all previous thresholds of possibility

**Make Bold Decisions **- We are creating a new world. Be optimistic, adventurous, and courageous. Leap fearlessly into the future

**Always Build Trust** - Say what you mean, mean what you say, and do what you say you’re going to do. We are all owners. We are one team

**Never Stop Growing **- Change IS the constant. Stay hungry and curious. Be relentless in the pursuit of progress

**Find a way **- Never settle, no excuses, nothing is impossible. Just make it happen

**Be the owner** - Drive with intensity and take total responsibility for the outcome. It's on you.

Our values guide us, and our mission drives us. Come join us and help deliver financial wellness for the whole family, putting the tools of wealth-making into everyone’s hands.

**Growth Marketing, Sr. Associate - New Channels | Acorns**

Acorns is hiring a Growth Marketing Sr. Associate to own new channel testing, starting with Snapchat. You will run each channel end to end, find and test the next ones, and drive user growth across Acorns and Acorns Early. You will report to the Senior Paid Acquisition Manager, who sets direction and leaves you room to run.

You will work independently from the first week. We are a small team that moves fast, and we want someone who thrives in a scrappy, startup-like environment. You've built something from nothing before, whether that's launching a new acquisition channel, developing a growth strategy, or finding a way to drive meaningful results with limited resources. You're resourceful, comfortable with ambiguity, and know how to turn small experiments into scalable growth. You will make daily calls on budget, bids, and creative, and bring a point of view on where we should spend next. You will partner with Analytics, Creative, and channel reps to take a test from idea to scale.

Acorns is a remote-first organization, offering the flexibility to work remotely while providing optional access to office space in Irvine, CA.

**What You Will DoChannel Ownership & Execution**

- Own testing across all new channels, starting with Snapchat, end to end: account setup, budget, tracking, launch, and optimization.

- Make the daily CPA and LTV:CAC calls: when to scale, when to hold, and when to kill a test.

- Build and run a testing roadmap for emerging channels we are not on yet. Every test has a plan, success criteria, and a kill threshold.

- Brief Creative on what each platform and audience responds to, and iterate on assets based on results.

- Bring tradeoffs, such as scale versus efficiency or a new channel versus a proven one, to the Senior Paid Acquisition Manager with your recommendation attached.

**Measurement & Reporting**

- Pull and analyze your own performance data across platform dashboards, your MMP, and backend results, and reconcile the differences.

- Set tests up to succeed: clean design, tracking verified before launch, and a QA pass before any spend.

- Identify incrementality and lift study opportunities, work with Analytics on the test structure, and own launch and monitoring of each experiment.

- Report results with the decision attached: what we found and what we are doing about it.

- Keep a running record of test results, including the ones that failed, so each test shapes the next roadmap.

**Cross-Brand & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

- Drive acquisition growth across Acorns and Acorns Early.

- Work closely with Analytics, Creative, and other marketing teammates to run experiments efficiently. We want someone who is easy to work with and makes the team around them better.

- Track where advertising is heading and bring us ideas for emerging channels unprompted, each with a hypothesis and a test plan.

**What You Will Bring**

- 4-5+ years in performance marketing or paid social with a BS/BA, or equivalent work experience.

- **You thrive in scrappy, startup-like environments.** You've built and launched a growth strategy or paid channel from zero to one, working with limited budgets and resources. You know how to be resourceful, test quickly, and find creative ways to make things work. You can point to something you built from scratch that delivered measurable results and helped scale the business.

- You have owned at least one paid social channel end to end (Meta, Snapchat, TikTok, Reddit, or similar), including setup, budget, tracking, and in-platform optimization. Managing an agency alone does not meet this bar.

- You have run direct-response optimization: you make CPA and/or ROAS decisions, read test results honestly, and know when to scale or cut.

- You have taken a channel that was new to your company and made it work, and you can share the results.

- You pull and analyze your own data, with spreadsheets as your baseline, and can explain where a number came from and why platform-reported results differ from backend results. You have working knowledge of MMPs (Adjust, AppsFlyer), pixels, SDKs, and last-touch attribution. You understand what incrementality testing and MMM are and why they matter, even if you have not run them yourself.

- You bring channel ideas with a test plan and kill criteria, and you stay current on industry trends instead of leaning on the same playbook.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; you follow processes carefully, flag questions early, and aren’t afraid to modify your approach when the situation calls for it.You are careful with details: you verify tracking, QA setups before spend, and catch what others miss in the data and the creative.

- You can explain the tradeoffs behind a call you made, and what you took from a test that failed.

- You communicate clearly in writing and conversation, and can turn experiment results into a recommendation stakeholders can act on.

- You believe your work connects to something bigger. Helping everyday people build financial security is core to what we do, and we want teammates energized by that.

You are not expected to have experience with every platform listed. If you’re passionate about Acorns’ mission and eager to grow in performance marketing, we encourage you to apply.

**What we offer:**

- Competitive salary and stock options

- A comprehensive benefits package for you and your family

- Flexible work location, hours, and paid time off

- 401(k) matching

- Monthly Acorns account contribution & GoHenry account for your family

- Mindfulness and Financial Wellness resources, Headspace and Addition Wealth

- Acorns Career Development Program (Ongoing training sessions, development plans, development check-ins, Cornerstone’s online training platform)

- Roots Leadership Program for Emerging Leaders

- Community week onsite gatherings and various virtual events

- Talented and motivated team members who care deeply about one another, our mission, and our customers.

- The rare opportunity to create a new world. We inspire one another every day to do meaningful work that solves big societal challenges.

**About Acorns:**

Acorns is the financial wellness company helping everyday Americans grow their money for the long term. Since 2014, Acorns has grown into a global company with multiple life stage products serving the needs of kids, teens, adults, and parents. Named one of America's Best Financial Services of 2026 by TIME, Acorns has served over 16 million people and helped customers save & invest over $33 billion dollars, much of it from spare change and small amounts.

The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between $75,000-$111,500/year; however, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including equity grants and discretionary cash bonus awards in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. description_md:
**ABOUT CODEWAY**

Codeway builds category-leading consumer AI apps on mobile and web, at global scale.

600M+ downloads. 60+ apps. 400+ builders across Barcelona and İstanbul. Completely bootstrapped. No board. Profitable since year two.

Small teams move faster than big ones. But they need big resources to win at scale. Nobody starts from zero. The problem decides the solution, not us.

We turn category wins into six focused vertical companies: Wishlabs (AI Creativity), Wellture (Wellness), Learna (Education), Sparked (Media), Cosmic Jam (Entertainment), and Catalyst Apps (Utilities & Productivity). Each has full ownership and the depth to go further than anyone else in its space.

Codeway HQ powers them all. One platform. One team that finds and grows builders. One set of guardrails. Every idea born here starts with an unfair advantage: the platform, the people, and the profits of every product before it. That's the system.

Turns out you can do both.

Move like an indie. Hit like a giant.

**POSITION**

At Codeway, we're redefining the performance marketing role. Here, you won't just analyze data and optimize campaigns; you'll also participate in creative discussions, manage global network relationships, and contribute to strategic decisions that shape Codeway’s future vision.

The ideal candidate is an exceptional all-rounder: good with people, comfortable with data, a self-starter who’s not afraid of failing, capable of generating creative ad ideas, and deeply curious about all aspects of growth.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

- **Claim 360 ownership** of an app’s marketing & execute end-to-end user acquisition strategies.

- **Manage the Creative Pipeline.** Develop and test creatives: come up with ideas, propose hypotheses, monitor implementation, and give feedback.

- **Manage and optimize user acquisition campaigns** across Meta, TikTok, Google and other networks.

- **Build meaningful relationships** with external partners and agencies, and manage collaborations with ad networks such as Meta London, TikTok Dubai, Apple London, and Google Dublin teams.

- **Build and monitor BI dashboards** for insights, and ensure campaigns achieve target KPIs while scaling.

- **Collaborate closely with the product team** to understand user motivations and shape effective monetization strategies.

- **Take additional responsibilities **to grow your app. Get creative, think beyond performance marketing, and apply out-of-the-box growth-hacking techniques.

**
WHAT YOU'LL BRING**

- **Experience.** You have a minimum of 2 years of experience in performance marketing or a related field, with a solid foundation and a strong desire to further your growth.

- **Passion.** Passion for mobile marketing, data, creative production.

- **Take the wheel.** You’re ready to get your hands dirty. You’re hard-working, you refuse to give up until achieving what you want to get. You’re result-driven and always aim for excellence in the work you do.

- **Ownership.** We want you to be ready to own every aspect of your project. You won’t be a newcomer here; you’ll own your thing.

- **Cool vibe.** You’re open to constructive criticism and feedback. You’re ready to improve yourself accordingly.

- **Excellent communication skills.** You’ll wear multiple hats as you work with marketing artists, product managers, external partners, and your peers within the performance team.

- **Excellent command of English.** You’ll manage a creative pipeline that mainly targets the United States audience, and manage joint partnerships with external networks and agencies.

 

**WHAT WE OFFER**

· **Great Place to Work.** As our top team member, you'll be a part of a fast-growing startup and have the privilege to enjoy our accredited “BEST WORKPLACES” environment, ranked first among all workplaces.

· **A Competitive Compensation Package.** Long story short, we take care of you.

· **A Meal Compensation.** That is actually enough for a decent & nutritious lunch, we’re not following the industry standard.

· **Full Health Benefits.** To keep you away from all the trouble, we provide unlimited private health insurance and cover the HPV vaccine.

· **Pet Adoption Support.** We cover the primary healthcare expenses, parasite vaccinations, and microchip costs that may arise within the first year after employees adopt a pet.

· **Cool Tech Stack.** Macbook, iPhone 15 Pro, magic mouse, magic keyboard; an adjustable desk with a 4K screen and any other gadget you may need in your job.

· **Sport Activities Support.** We care about your physical wellbeing and support your gym membership.

· **Learning Never Ends!** Training budget to help you grow in your role, gain new skills, and learn new things.

· **Udemy Free Pass.** An unlimited Udemy subscription.

· **Flexible Schedule & Unlimited Vacations.** This isn’t a “clock in, clock out” company. We care about your productivity, not tracking every minute you’re on site. It’s up to you to always be responsible with your work, no matter where you are or what schedule you’re keeping.

· **English Course Support.** Be more global and perform best at your work.

· **Comprehensive Well-being Support.** Through our partnership with Meditopia, we now offer free psychological counseling, along with additional services like dietitian, personal trainer, parenting consultant, physiotherapist, child & adolescent therapist, and face-to-face counseling for employees in Istanbul.

· **A Top-Notch Office.** Located at the heart of Istanbul, right next to Levent Metro Station at Ferko Signature.

· **Codebrew.** Yes, you’ve heard it right: We love coffee so much that we’ve built our own coffee shop inside our office, where we also provide healthy snacks at certain hours.

· **Free Breakfast.** At Codebrew - every morning at 9:30 AM.

· **No Dress Code.** Dress as you like.

· **Happy Hours Every Friday.** Every. Single. Friday. When it’s 5 PM: Screens off, party on! (Check out Codeway on Instagram)

· **Dream Team.** Average Codeway member is young, talented, and passionate - which makes our working environment extremely dynamic. Need proof? Take a look at our Instagram.

· **Gaming Area.** Whenever you need to take a break from hard work and relax with your favorite games, our PS5 corner will be waiting for you.

· **Software Support.** Subscription to any software you might need to perform at your best.

· **Public Transportation Support.** Daily public transportation support is on us, covered by an additional monthly compensation.

· **Parent Support.** Becoming a parent is a big moment, and Codeway celebrates it with you. We offer a one-time grant to support our new parents.

· **Massage Room.** When you need a moment to recharge and unwind, our massage chair room will be ready to offer you a relaxing break.

**
THE RECRUITING PROCESS**

We are committed to keeping our recruitment process short and transparent. Here’s how it looks like:

- **Application:** Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile. You can also just write a few words about yourself.

- **Talent & Culture Interview:** Let’s talk about your experience & expectations and see what we can achieve together.

- **Case Study:** We might send you a task to solve.

- **Technical Interview:** You will meet with your future team lead to go over the case and your technical capabilities in detail.

- **Reference Check:** We will contact your references to gain insights into your past experiences and work ethic.

- **Welcome Aboard!** You are now a part of the team.

description_md:
**About Voodoo**

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

**Team**

Yuzu is building a portfolio of real money gaming apps, combining accessible mobile gameplay with competition and real cash prizes. We’re currently developing our first games, with the ambition to launch and grow several apps.
We’re a small team working across product, creative production and growth, using AI to prototype ideas, create content and test quickly. Joining Yuzu means getting involved before launch, taking ownership of projects and helping shape both the games we build and the way we work.

**Role**

You will work closely with the team building the product and launching the business. You will contribute across creative production, AI workflows and early growth, with room to suggest ideas and take them through to execution.
Your role is to turn ideas into things we can use and test: creative assets, playable prototypes, useful workflows and experiments that help us move towards launch.

- **Produce creative content.** Develop concepts and create videos, visuals, animations and gameplay content for our marketing. Take an idea from a first draft to an asset we can put in front of users.

- **Build systems with AI.** Turn repetitive work into practical workflows for research, content production and testing. Create reusable templates and lightweight automations, and check the quality of the outputs.

- **Benchmark widely.** Explore competing games and relevant consumer apps. Study their creatives, onboarding, gameplay and reward systems, then turn your observations into ideas we can try.

- **Prototype interactive experiences.** Use AI, no-code or coding tools to build demos, small game concepts and playable ads. Learn the tools needed to get a first version working.

- **Run frequent experiments.** Quickly test different creative angles, formats and interactions. Be clear about what you want to learn, review the results and recommend what to try next.

- **Help get the business ready to launch.** Produce and organise launch assets and materials, spot gaps and pick up practical tasks with the team. Follow through until they are done.

 

**Profile**

- You are a final-year student or recent graduate, ideally from an **engineering school or a leading business school**. You learn quickly, enjoy unfamiliar problems and want to help launch a new business in real money gaming.

- **You build things on your own.** You have side projects to show: a small product, a website, a content project, a game prototype or an automation. You can explain what you made and how you approached it.

- **You are comfortable working with AI.** You already use AI to research, create and solve practical problems. You enjoy combining tools into repeatable workflows and improving how work gets done.

- **You have a knack for content. **Experience with image and video generation, editing tools, AI coding assistants, no-code workflows or simple scripting will be useful. A good visual eye and an interest in consumer products will also help.

- **You are curious and analytical.** You like exploring products, comparing approaches and testing ideas. You can break down a problem, identify a useful first experiment and explain what you learned.

- **You take initiative and follow through.** You are comfortable switching between creative, technical and business tasks. You can make progress independently, ask for feedback and flag blockers early.

- **You work well in French and English.** You speak fluent French and have strong written and spoken English. You can communicate your ideas clearly and research unfamiliar topics independently.

**Nice to have:You have a feel for games.** You explore new games and notice what makes a mechanic satisfying or an experience engaging. Card games, tournament formats and risk-and-reward mechanics are familiar territory.

We will value your ability to learn, choose the right tools and deliver work that we can use.

 

**Benefits**

- Competitive salary upon experience, plus bonus

- Swile Lunch voucher

- Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)

- Premium healthcare coverage SideCare, for your family, 100% covered by Voodoo

- Wellness activities in our Paris office

title: Growth Associate - Gaming

company.name: Homa
company.blurb: Mobile games publisher (hyper/hybrid-casual).

description_md:
Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world's best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor.

Since the start, we've raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who've built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.

At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

**The opportunity**

At Homa, growth is about more than optimizing campaigns. It's about finding new ways to scale.

As a Growth Associate, you'll analyze performance, identify untapped opportunities, and turn insights into growth strategies for our mobile games. You'll work across Data, Product, Creative, and User Acquisition to challenge assumptions, test hypotheses, and drive measurable impact. We're looking for analytical problem-solvers who think beyond established playbooks. You don't need gaming or UA experience. You need sharp thinking, curiosity, and the drive to figure things out.

**What you'll do**

- **Analyze.** Investigate performance data, market dynamics, and competitor strategies to identify growth opportunities.
- **Challenge.** Question assumptions, uncover bottlenecks, and find unconventional ways to scale.
- **AI Automation.** Use AI and data tools to streamline analysis, build workflows, and accelerate growth.
- **Discover.** Track emerging trends, ad networks, creative strategies, and new acquisition opportunities.
- **Experiment.** Turn hypotheses into tests, coordinate cross-functional teams, and measure results.
- **Drive.** Take ownership from insight to execution, aligning teams and pushing initiatives forward

**Requirements**

- **Analytical experience.** Background in data, consulting, finance, business analysis, operations, or a similarly quantitative field. You break down complex problems, identify patterns, and make data-driven decisions.

- **Strategic.** You challenge conventional approaches and look for better ways to solve problems.
- **Proactive.** You identify opportunities, create your own priorities, and drive action without waiting for instructions.
- **High ownership.** You take responsibility for outcomes and see problems through to resolution.
- **AI-driven.** You use AI to automate, analyze, and solve problems in new ways.
- **Clear thinker.** You structure ideas, communicate simply, and turn analysis into actionable recommendations.
- **Problem-solving skills.** Evidence of turning ambiguous problems into actionable solutions.
- **Data fluency.** Confidence working with quantitative data and spreadsheets. SQL, Python, and BI tools are a plus.
- **Project ownership.** Ability to manage multiple priorities and drive cross-functional initiatives without formal authority.

**Why Homa**

- **Exceptional growth.** Take on challenging problems and accelerate your development.
- **Real ownership.** Drive initiatives with measurable business impact.
- **Cross-functional exposure.** Work across Data, Product, Creative, and UA.
- **High talent bar.** Learn alongside ambitious, high-performing teams.
- **AI at the core.** Use cutting-edge AI to rethink how growth works.

**Our Culture**

At Homa, we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, act with pragmatism, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

- **Humility:** We recognise that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow - we stay grounded in a clear view of ourselves.
- **Curiosity:** We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what” - we explore with purpose and practicality.
- **Focus:** Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider - we obsess over the details and let pragmatism guide our attention.
- **Ambition:** We strive for the best - we don’t settle for “good enough,” - we use common sense to reach higher.

**Benefits**

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here’s what you can expect:

- **🏥 Comprehensive Benefits:** Depending on your location, you’ll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.
- **🏢 Paris HQ Access:** Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.
- **🌍 Coworking Access:** You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.
- **🌐 Global Team:** Collaborate in English with top-tier talent from 35+ countries, spanning Europe, the UK, the US, and more. Diversity fuels our creativity and innovation.
- **✈️ Team Gatherings:** We value time together beyond the screen. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.
- **📈 Performance Reviews:** We’re committed to your growth. Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize your achievements, and align on clear development goals.
- **💻 Equipment Support:** From day one, we’ll provide everything you need to do your best work, including a home office setup allowance if you’re working remotely.

**Where We Hire**

Our HQ in Paris is a vibrant hub of creativity, collaboration, and connection. From rooftop lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, we’ve designed a space people genuinely enjoy - all within a cosy WeWork filled with good energy (and snacks).

We also have incredible team members across Europe - from Spain and Turkey to Germany, North Macedonia, Poland, the UK, and more. Whether you’re working from a sunny WeWork in Barcelona or your home setup in Warsaw, you’re fully part of our culture. To keep collaboration smooth, we primarily hire within European time zones (UTC to UTC+3). If you’re based there - or planning to be - we’d love to hear from you!

1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. **Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access.** We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.

But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.

We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.

description_md:

**TripledotStudios** is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who **LOVE** making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

This role will be working at our Clipwire Games studio.

Clipwire Games is one of Canada's top grossing mobile game developers, and the creator of Monopoly: Bingo!, TPIR: Bingo! and Bingo Story. Founded in Toronto over 10 years ago, we’ve had tremendous success and are poised for another decade of record growth. Our studio is built on strong values, work ethic, and intelligent data driven growth. We work hard, have fun, innovate, and level-up every day.

To work at Clipwire means becoming part of our future right now. We have reached our current growth rate because we support, promote, and develop our team so that they can make great games. Come find out what all the buzz is about!

**Role Overview**

We’re looking for a Growth Director to own how Clipwire’s games find and keep their players. You’ll lead paid and organic acquisition, ad monetisation, UA creative, creative production, lifecycle, social, and VIP player support, with accountability for profitable growth across our three live titles.
This isn’t just a UA role. You’ll shape how acquisition, creative, measurement, monetisation, and product work together to grow the business. This is a senior leadership role reporting to the CEO, leading our Growth organization through its functional leads.

**
Responsibilities**

- Own the growth strategy, annual plan, budget, and performance targets across our portfolio of live games.

- Lead our UA, creative, monetisation, and lifecycle functions, developing strong leaders and high-performing teams.

- Own paid and organic acquisition strategy, investment allocation, measurement, attribution, and experimentation.

- Own ad monetisation strategy and revenue, including mediation, network partnerships, bidding, and eCPM optimization, partnering with Product on placements and frequency to balance ad revenue with player experience.

- Make creative a major growth lever, setting the strategy and bar for creative testing, velocity, innovation, and performance.

- Use data to uncover opportunities across acquisition, retention, monetisation, and product, and turn them into high-impact growth experiments.

- Partner closely with Product, LiveOps, Economy Design, Creative, and Data Science to improve LTV and unlock new opportunities for scale.

- Own lifecycle management across our player base, leading win-back and reactivation of lapsed players and VIP programs that retain and grow our highest-value players.

- Champion the use of AI across the Growth team, building AI-powered processes and workflows across UA, creative, lifecycle, and VIP support to increase speed, scale, and quality.

- Establish clear operating rhythms and report growth performance, opportunities, and investment recommendations to senior leadership.

**Requirements**

- 5+ years of experience in mobile gaming growth, performance marketing, or user acquisition, including experience at significant scale.

- Proven experience owning and scaling multi-million-dollar UA budgets across major mobile advertising channels.

- Deep understanding of mobile growth economics, including LTV, ROAS, attribution, incrementality, and performance measurement.

- Strong creative strategy and testing experience, with a track record of using creative to drive UA performance.

- Experience identifying and driving growth opportunities across UA, monetisation, retention, and product.

- An analytical and experimental mindset, with the ability to make high-value decisions quickly from imperfect data.

- Strong cross-functional and executive communication skills, with the autonomy to set direction and influence senior stakeholders.

- Experience in free-to-play mobile games, strong preference for casual, casino, or other hybrid monetisation models

You'll own the pipeline from creative brainstorming through final delivery for ads to run across brand and performance marketing campaigns. This isn't about making one perfect ad. description_md:
Do you have a data-driven mindset and find the thought of applying analytics to creative campaigns for mobile games exhilarating?

Working on category-leading sports mobile games and growing them further excites you?

This just might be the role for you!

We are looking for a Senior User Acquisition Manager to join our UA team and become the driving force behind scaling the player base and maximizing revenue for one of our category-leading titles, Golf Rival. While your primary focus will be championing growth for Golf Rival, you will be part of a world class UA hub that oversees four major sports powerhouse titles within the Zynga and Take-Two Interactive portfolio: Top Eleven Football Manager, Golf Rival, CSR Racing 2, and Top Goal: Football Champion.

**THE DIFFERENCE YOU’LL MAKE:**

- In this role, you won’t be just executing campaigns - you will act as a true business owner driving the commercial success of a world-class mobile game. By mastering the intersection of data, media buying, and creative strategy, your decisions will directly fuel our global growth and efficiently scale multi-million-dollar budgets

- Because we operate in small, agile teams, your impact will be immediate and visible across the studio. Whether you are unlocking a highly profitable new channel, pioneering a breakthrough creative concept, or proactively driving a new cross-functional initiative, your work will directly put our games into the hands of millions of new players and shape the future of Nordeus within the Zynga and Take-Two Interactive family

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**

- Work within a small, agile, and multifunctional marketing team dedicated to a specific game. We don't believe in red tape- you will enjoy a high level of autonomy, empowering you to make fast, strategic decisions that have a direct and measurable impact on the product’s overarching success

- Plan, execute, and optimize multi-million-dollar UA campaigns across global markets and major ad networks (Meta, Google, AppLovin, Unity, TikTok, PPE networks, etc.)

- Deep-dive into campaign data and analytics to uncover actionable insights. You will track, report, and forecast performance, running rigorous A/B tests to improve campaign efficiencies. Collaborate closely with our dedicated Analytics team to help them build advanced predictive models, further optimise reporting tools and constantly refine our LTV formulas

- Champion the UA creative process. Partner closely with the Creative and Art teams to brainstorm, test, and iterate on high-performing ad creatives, understanding exactly what visual elements drive conversion and lower CPIs.

- We value proactive thinkers and entrepreneurs at heart. Beyond your core UA duties, you will have the freedom to shape your own career trajectory and role. You are encouraged to proactively identify untapped opportunities, suggest innovative growth strategies, and drive additional cross-functional initiatives that help us smash our studio goals

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

- Marketing Creative and Art team: Work hand-in-hand to brainstorm, test, and iterate on ad concepts, turning your performance insights into high-converting visual masterpieces

- Marketing Analytics: Partner up to refine LTV formulas, elevate predictive modeling, and ensure every strategic media buying decision is backed by bulletproof data

- Product Marketing team: Align your user acquisition tactics with overall brand positioning, app store optimization (ASO), and broader go-to-market campaigns to ensure a seamless player journey from ad view to install

- Product team: Bridge the gap between marketing and development by sharing market trends and acquisition insights, helping to inform live ops and in-game features that drive long-term retention and monetization

**WE ARE A MATCH, IF YOU:**

- Have 3 to 5+ years of hands-on experience in User Acquisition / Performance Marketing (Experience in Mobile Gaming is highly preferred, but strong backgrounds in Mobile Apps or Web Performance Marketing are also welcome)

- Have a proven track record of managing and scaling large advertising budgets (comfortably handling $500k - $1M+ per month)

- Have exceptional analytical skills with the ability to manipulate and interpret complex data sets, work with MMPs (e.g., AppsFlyer, Adjust), and translate numbers into clear marketing strategies

- Have a deep understanding of what makes a winning ad creative and how to continuously iterate on concepts

- Have a strong strategic and commercial mindset. You don’t just look at the CPIs; you look at the ROI, LTV, and overall business growth.

- Have an ability to operate effectively in a team-oriented and collaborative environment

- Are curious and committed to fast and lifelong learning

- Are a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, high-impact environment

**BONUS POINTS:**

- A Player at Heart: A genuine passion for mobile gaming, the broader tech landscape, or sports (specifically football, golf, or racing). You understand the player mindset because you are a player

- Ad-Tech Savvy: A deep, structural understanding of the mobile marketing ecosystem. You are well-versed in marketing measurement tools, mobile attribution (MMPs like AppsFlyer or Adjust), programmatic advertising, and predictive modeling

- Technical Chops: Hands-on experience with SQL and data visualization tools (like Tableau) to pull your own data and build custom dashboards without waiting on others

- AI-Empowered: You proactively leverage AI tools to streamline your workflows, speed up creative ideation, and multiply your daily efficiency

**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE:**

- **The team behind the game:** transparency and trust from day one, paired with a strong sense of teamwork- that's the essence of who we are. It's not just what you do - it’s how you do it and who you do it with. With 280+ teammates from around the world, we’re on a mission to bring the joy of winning to millions.

- **We make your life at Nordeus hassle-free: **enjoy Nordeus provided breakfast, lunch, snacks, and beverages, a fully-equipped gym, organized sports activities (yoga, Brazilian jiu-jitsu, basketball, football), an ergonomic workstation, top-notch tech equipment (including laptop, mobile phone and bill coverage, and other tech), a kids’ playroom, a music corner, board and video games + latest consoles.

- **Perks? We’ve got plenty:** premium private medical insurance for you and your family,  flexible working hours, take-what-you-need vacation policy, offsites abroad for the whole company, fully-paid maternity and paternity leave, employee stock purchase plan, access to L&D platforms and opportunities and many more.

- **Make your mark on games played by millions:** with over 300M registered users, Top Eleven is the world’s most successful football management game. Golf Rival, with more than 60M registered users, is the #2 mobile golf game, aiming to claim the top spot. With one more game in the works, we are continuing our efforts to create powerful mobile sports gaming experiences built to last.

- **Meaningful career experience: **work with experienced game makers and mentors who will support you from day one, helping you map a career path that's true to you.

- **Impact beyond the screen:** It is not just about us. We are part of something bigger than a job. We create a better future for generations to come through the efforts of the Nordeus Foundation.

**GOOD TO KNOW:**

- If you are not from Serbia, learn more about our relocation package.

- This is a hybrid, on-site position based in Belgrade.

- Our **3+2 hybrid model** remains the standard - Monday to Wednesday in the office, Thursday and Friday are optional remote days. While we prefer working together from the office, we also understand that having some alone time or working from home (or some other location) can be beneficial. It’s about what works, not what’s prescribed.

What you’ll be doing

Someone who can own color grading and/or audio engineering in our post production process. In this role, you’ll share the video post-production process end to end with another editor: editing, collaborating with our motion graphics designers, and delivering polished final outputs. You’ll also shape campaign storytelling by editing commercial spots into engaging, channel-specific cuts while preserving core messaging.

- **Strategic Thinking: **Understanding of how video ads fit into broader business objectives and marketing strategies.

- **Quality Control: **Ensure all content is clear, compelling, and free of grammatical errors, while maintaining consistency with brand voice and guidelines.

- **Create Engaging Visual Content: **Develop compelling videos for various media platforms including digital media and social media advertising

- **Post-Production: **Maintain the integrity of the color grading **or **audio mastering, and motion graphic renders to deliver the final outputs for our video assets. Effectively editing our main campaign spots into shorter versions. Reformatting said spots for all other formats; including reformatting motion renders and localization for other language markets.

- **Technical Execution: **Utilize industry-standard software (e.g., Adobe Premiere, etc.) to produce high-quality edits and light compositing, ensuring consistency and attention to detail.

title: ASO Specialist

company.name: Supercell
company.blurb: Helsinki studio behind Clash of Clans, Clash Royale and Brawl Stars.

description_md:
**We are seeking an experienced App Store Optimization (ASO) Specialist to join our Media & Ops team as we continue to drive our growth story forward!**

The mission is to increase the visibility and downloads of our existing games. As our App Store Optimization Specialist, you will be responsible for developing and implementing effective ASO strategies to improve the visibility and download rates of our games on the Apple App Store and Google Play.

**What You'll Be Doing**

- Devise strategies and project plans to improve App Store ranking and drive organic installs

- Coordinate and managing projects from inception through to completion, working with internal and external stakeholders across creative, product, marketing and other business functions

- Execute A/B testing to increase conversions, establishing best practices, documenting results and implementing in the stores

- Contributing to keyword optimisation strategies

- Monitor app store performance metrics and analyze data to identify areas for improvement and optimization

- Create localisation strategies for our top markets

- Work with our UA team to create Custom Product Pages & Custom Store Listings to support their activities

- Support new games to launch

**What You Have**

- Strong understanding of App Store Algorithms

- Experience supporting keyword optimisation strategies

- Knowledge of data analysis

- Ability to create reports

- Keeping up-to-date with the latest trends and best practices in mobile digital marketing and ASO

- Strong communication and collaboration skills

- Strong creativity skills

- Good innovative skills

- Experience planning and conducting A/B testing in collaboration with related business functions

- Understanding of how the upper funnel and down funnel metrics work

- Experience with app store analytics, and ASO platforms, (e.g. AppRadar, AppTweak)

**Would Be Nice if You Also Have**

- +3 years of experience in ASO management, preferably in the mobile gaming industry

- Established background in marketing, product or product marketing

- Extremely organized with solid project management skills

- Excellent communication skills both written and verbal

**Where You'll Be**

This position can be based in Helsinki or London, as we have game teams in these two cities.

–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read.

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page.

–––

**About Supercell **

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

**Hey, You Might Love It Here!**

Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.

**You Are Not Your Job Title ™**

Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

**Benefits and Compensation **

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.

**Relocation? Yes!**

No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!

**Not Sure if You Should Apply? **

Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

**Join Truecaller – The place where innovation meets impact!**

We stay collaborative and focused, always searching for smarter paths forward. If you want to make an impact and grow with a team that inspires millions, you’ll fit right in.

**The role:**

As the **Head of User Growth**, you will serve as an executive leader accountable for driving Truecaller’s global expansion engine. This will include organic growth using product optimisations as well as inorganic growth globally using advertising/distribution partnerships, etc.

At the intersection of **Data Analytics, Performance Marketing, User Acquisition, and Product-Led Growth (PLG)**, you will architect scalable growth strategies, establish global playbooks, and lead cross-functional expansion of our platform.

This executive position requires a seasoned leader with **10+ years of total industry leadership experience** in growing **consumer apps globally. **

This **role is transferable** to our headquarters in **Stockholm**, Sweden, after 6 months of strong performance.

**Note: Anyone from around the world can apply for this role.What you’ll do:

      Executive Ownership**

- **End-to-End User Growth:** Own the global growth budget and P&L, balancing performance marketing with product-led viral loops to optimize contribution margin, payback periods, and LTV, not vanity metrics.

- **Cross-Disciplinary Integration:** Align Performance Marketing, Mobile Measurement Partners (MMP) analytics, Monetization, Product Growth, and User Acquisition with corporate goals.

- **Team Scaling & Leadership:** Mentor and scale the existing team consisting of cross-functional people.

- **Global Market Playbooks:** Build repeatable market-entry frameworks to unlock new international regions (LATAM, SEA, US, Europe) while driving incrementality across established markets.

- Obsess over metrics that drive user growth in each country

- Experiment with ideas that could change growth trajectory

- Monitor and optimise user acquisition spend

- Create flows / optimise product areas that can yield accelerated user growth and revenue growth

**What you bring in: **

- Overall 18+ years of experience in consumer apps and product management.

- **10+ years **of professional leadership experience, with demonstrated leadership across Data Analytics, Performance Marketing, User Acquisition (UA), Retention, and Product Management.

- **Proven experience** growing a consumer app in India as well as globally

- **Hands-on Mastery of Analytics & UA:** Deep technical knowledge of cohort economics, incrementality testing, attribution modelling, etc.

- **Executive Leadership:** Track record of building, scaling, and managing multi-disciplinary growth organisations at a Senior Director/VP level.

- Ability to synthesise complex analytical insights into clear, actionable strategies for executive stakeholders and board members.

- Strong business judgment when evaluating incrementality tests, marketing spend, and attribution data.

- Approachable, collaborative leadership style that thrives in an international, multi-cultural setting.

**It would be great if you have:**

Experience scaling a consumer appfrom early growth to significant scale, or successfully taking a product through a 0-to-1 growth phase.

Direct experience scaling consumer products across multiple countries, particularly in emerging and established international markets.

Prior experience in a product-led technology company or high-growth startup.

Exposure to subscription, advertising or other consumer-app monetisation models.

Experience using AI and automation to improve growth efficiency, experimentation or decision-making.

**What we offer: **

We support growth through learning resources, leadership programs, mentoring, and real hands-on work. People can move between teams and projects to build new skills and keep things interesting. We offer clear internal mobility and a transparent path for progression, with leaders who stay involved and provide guidance throughout the year. In addition, you will benefit from:

- **A comprehensive compensation package: ** Learning and development allowance, voluntary provident fund (VPF) and/or national pension scheme (NPS) tax saving option provided, creche allowance

- **Modern tools to do your best work: **Choose your preferred computer and phone within our budget, so you can work comfortably and efficiently.

- **A people-focused office culture: **We value in-person collaboration and follow an office-first model, with some flexibility. Our offices offer a vibrant environment with opportunities to learn, connect, and recharge, from breakfast, lunch and quiet spaces to team activities such as movie nights, tech meetups, and cultural events. There's something for everyone.

- **Truecaller’s “Lab Days”** offer a space for imagination: 5 days each quarter, where everyone steps away from their normal tasks to explore new, bold ideas and build things they’ve always wanted to. It’s a space where curiosity leads the way, and prototypes take shape. Some concepts even make it into production, and a few have grown into real features used by millions today. Lab Days allow you to be creative, learn fast, and help shape Truecaller's future.

**
Come as you are:**
Truecaller is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe that a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences strengthens our products and our culture. No matter where you're from, what language you speak, or how you identify,  we value what makes you unique and would love to get to know you.

**
Sounds like a great opportunity?**

We will fill the position as soon as we find the right candidate, so please send your application as soon as possible. As part of the recruitment process, we will conduct a background check.

We only accept applications **in English**.
