title: Business Analyst - Growth & User Acquisition

company.name: Wildlife Studios
company.blurb: One of the world's largest mobile game companies, behind Zooba and Tennis Clash.

description_md:
**Help us decide how to scale our games and where to invest to maximize growth! **

We're looking for a Business Analyst - Growth & User Acquisition to help decide how Wildlife should grow its portfolio, scale its player base, and invest our marketing budget. You’ll be part of Product Marketing team at Wildlife Studios.

Our team is where the growth strategy for our games takes shape. We take our titles, put them in front of real players, and ask: how do we make this work at a massive scale? That means figuring out not just who wants to play, but how to find them and acquire them efficiently. You'll work across experimentation, modeling, product analytics, market and distribution strategy, and investment decisions. You'll need to understand the product, challenge assumptions, figure out what the data can actually tell us, and turn that into a clear recommendation: who should we target, how do we reach those players, and how much should we invest?

We work with games across their entire lifecycle, driving growth for titles played by millions. Throughout that journey, the work is the same: understand the product deeply, dig into the data, optimize performance, and figure out the best strategy to distribute and scale it.

If you like working in a dynamic place, digging into complex data to drive strategic investment decisions, and sitting close to the product to build true growth strategies rather than just executing downstream, this is the seat.

**What you'll do**

- **Analysis and experimentation:** Analyze player and game performance across engagement, monetization, and cost of acquisition, turning data into a clear read and recommendation. Help design and evaluate tests, from concept tests to soft launches, and be clear about what the data can and cannot prove.

- **Distribution strategy:** Help shape how a new game reaches players, including which markets, channels, audiences, and creative angles to test and at what cost. Analyze where investment should go across platforms like Meta, Google, and TikTok, and understand what each platform is actually optimizing

- **Support kill, iterate, and scale decisions:** Build the analysis and recommendations behind key product decisions, bringing a clear view of what the data tells us and what we should do next.

- **Modeling under uncertainty:** Work with early LTV, payback, and market-size models where data is limited. Understand the assumptions behind them and use them to inform investment and growth decisions.

- **Launch strategy:** For the games that graduate, help shape how they go global, including which markets open when, how fast to ramp, and how much to invest.

- **Problem prioritization:** New games generate more questions than we can answer. Use judgment to identify the problems and analyses most likely to change a product or investment decision, and proactively drive them forward.

- **Cross-functional teamwork:** Work alongside the game team, product, and creative across a title's whole life. Bring the market and player read into product discussions, including what players are responding to and what the numbers say the game still has to fix. Bring the product reality back into how the game gets positioned and distributed.

**What you'll need**

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Business, or equivalent practical experience.

- Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills ,  you can explain a model to someone who will never read the code.

- Working proficiency in SQL, plus Python or R.

- Comfort with incomplete data and questions that arrive badly defined.

**Nice to have**

- Familiarity with A/B testing, multivariate testing, and other methodologies for evaluating performance.

- Experience with large datasets, BI tooling, or building data pipelines.

- Previous experience in user acquisition, performance marketing, growth, banking, or consulting.

- Familiarity with the mobile gaming industry landscape.

**More about you**

- Proactive and autonomous; you drive initiatives without waiting for instructions, while ensuring necessary visibility and buy-in from key stakeholders.

- Thrives in high-demand environments and excels at prioritization.

- An exceptional communicator who can influence others ,  including telling a stakeholder their idea won't work, with the data to support it.

About Wildlife

Wildlife is one of the leading mobile game developers and publishers in the world. We have released more than 60 titles, reaching billions of people around the globe. Today, we have offices in Brazil, Argentina, Ireland, and the United States. Here, we create games that will excite, intrigue, and engage our players for years to come!

Equal Opportunity

Wildlife is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, colour, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law.

title: Performance Marketing Manager, Forecasting & Market Intelligence

description_md:
Scopely is looking for a **Performance Marketing Manager, Forecasting & Market Intelligence,** to join our Performance Marketing team in Canada on a remote basis.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day, whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers developing, publishing, and innovating across the games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

The Performance Marketing team helps drive sustainable player growth across Scopely’s portfolio. This role will sit at the intersection of performance marketing, forecasting, competitive intelligence, and market research, supporting active and upcoming Slate titles as they move from early planning through testing, soft launch, and global launch.

What You Will Do

You will build the analytical foundation behind UA forecasts and growth plans: identifying the right comparable titles, developing market and geo assumptions, maintaining benchmarks, tracking competitive signals, and turning incomplete information into structured first-pass recommendations. This is a highly analytical role for someone who enjoys working through ambiguity and can challenge, validate, and refine assumptions rather than taking inputs at face value.

- Develop first-pass performance marketing forecasts and supporting inputs for upcoming Slate titles, including install curves, geo-tier views, channel assumptions, paid and organic assumptions, and launch phasing.

- Build and maintain relevant comparable game-peer sets based on genre, monetization model, platform, geo mix, audience, launch strategy, creative approach, and expected scale.

- Develop and maintain dCPI benchmarks and degradation curves, combining Scopely historical performance, partner benchmarks, competitor data, and external market signals.

- Support organic forecasting by developing assumptions around baseline organic demand, paid-driven lift, launch/IP halo, virality, and organic-to-paid ratios.

- Build sensitivity analyses that make the impact of key assumptions clear and help teams understand the range of potential outcomes.

- Track competitor UA investment, creative trends, app-store movement, channel activity, launch performance, and regional signals across relevant games and genres.

- Produce recurring market-intelligence and competitive-pulse readouts that identify meaningful changes in the market and potential implications for Slate titles.

- Incorporate learnings from market research, beta acquisition, creative and audience testing, soft launch, and other pre-launch signals into forecast assumptions.

- Support regional opportunity sizing and geo strategy, including differences in acquisition cost, scale, organic potential, and market dynamics.

- Maintain clear assumption logs, source documentation, version history, confidence levels, and open questions so forecasts are auditable and reusable.

- Partner closely with Performance Marketing, Product, Strategic Marketing, Finance, Analytics, and other stakeholders to gather inputs and pressure-test assumptions.

- Proactively identify gaps, risks, or inconsistencies in forecasts and surface them before they become downstream planning issues.

- Support ad hoc Slate analyses and leadership requests with structured research, quantitative analysis, and clear first-pass readouts.

- Help improve and standardize forecasting methodologies, benchmark libraries, and analytical processes across Slate over time.

What We’re Looking For

- Strong experience in performance marketing, growth, marketing analytics, strategy, market intelligence, or a similarly analytical role, ideally within mobile games, mobile apps, or another consumer digital business.

- Strong understanding of mobile user acquisition fundamentals, including CPI, LTV, ROAS, retention, organic acquisition, channel mix, attribution, and marginal economics.

- Excellent analytical skills and the ability to turn incomplete or ambiguous information into structured assumptions and useful recommendations.

- Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills, including building and auditing analytical models, sensitivity analyses, and forecast frameworks.

- Strong attention to detail and a high bar formodel integrity, source quality, and assumption validation.

- Ability to independently pressure-test data and assumptions rather than accepting outputs at face value.

- Experience working with multiple data sources, including internal performance data, third-party market intelligence tools, partner benchmarks, and competitive research.

- Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Strong cross-functional working style and comfort partnering with teams across Marketing, Product, Finance, Analytics, and leadership.

- Curiosity about the games market and a desire to understand why titles grow, why acquisition economics differ, and how launch dynamics evolve over time.

- Ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams and operate effectively with limited oversight.

- Comfortable using AI and other analytical tools to accelerate research and analysis, while maintaining independent judgment and thoroughly validating outputs.

Bonus Points

- You are an avid gamer who understands products from a user’s perspective.

- Direct experience forecasting or supporting the launch of mobile games or consumer apps.

- Experience with tools such as Sensor Tower, data.ai, AppMagic, Looker, Appsflyer, Adjust, or similar platforms.

- Familiarity with global mobile UA markets and meaningful differences across the US, Tier 1 Western markets, Asia, and emerging regions.

- Experience analyzing competitor launches, creative strategy, market sizing, or portfolio-level performance.

- Familiarity with pre-launch testing, soft-launch methodology, or forecasting games with licensed or globally recognized IP.

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. - Develop and continuously evolve UA strategies through ongoing testing and experimentation. Proactively identify opportunities, formulate hypotheses, design tests, analyze results, and scale successful learnings across markets, platforms, and campaigns.

- Advance our internal tools and processes using dedicated engineering and analytics resources.

description_md:
We power people’s progress.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

Meet the team!

Organic Growth builds sustainable, compounding growth engines for Preply. Within the team, Product Led Growth and Pricing & Discounting are two strategic areas with the potential to unlock non-linear growth, improve learner lifetime value and strengthen the economics of our marketplace.

Product Led Growth already has a dedicated cross-functional product team, including Product, Design, Analytics and Engineering. Pricing and Discounting is the next area of strategic development, with further product investment planned as part of Preply's growth agenda.

You will report to the Senior Director of Organic Growth and take responsibility for agreed commercial KPIs across both areas. In your first year, your priorities will be to accelerate the performance and strategic development of Product Led Growth, while defining Preply's Pricing and Discounting strategy, principles and investment priorities.

You will initially manage one analyst responsible for day-to-day Product Led Growth analytics, with the potential to grow the team as the scope develops. This high-visibility role offers the opportunity to scale an established growth engine while building Preply's approach to Pricing and Discounting from the ground up. It is a full-time role based in Barcelona, combining regular collaboration in our office with the flexibility to work remotely.

**What you’ll be doing:**

- Own the business and product strategy for Product Led Growth and Pricing and Discounting, turning Preply's company priorities into clear choices, roadmaps and measurable commercial outcomes.

- Take responsibility for agreed commercial KPIs, including Product Led Growth NSGMV and share of NSGMV, incremental total lifetime value, margin and LTV to CAC efficiency.

- Accelerate Product Led Growth by identifying and prioritising opportunities across referrals, advocacy, sharing, incentives and other product-led acquisition and retention mechanics.

- Build Preply's Pricing and Discounting strategy across the marketplace, including our approach to tutor pricing, learner-facing prices, promotions, discounts, credits and incentives.

- Develop business cases, proofs of concept and MVPs that allow Preply to validate opportunities before making deeper product or organisational investments.

- Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Finance and other Growth leaders to shape roadmaps, design experiments and balance learner value, tutor outcomes, growth, margin and marketplace health.

- Own the performance and decision-making framework for the portfolio, ensuring teams have clear KPIs, reliable measurement and a regular cadence for reviewing progress and reallocating investment.

- Use quantitative and qualitative insight to identify strategic and tactical growth opportunities, challenge assumptions and turn complex analysis into clear recommendations.

- Build alignment across senior stakeholders and communicate strategy, trade-offs, progress and recommendations with clarity and conviction.

- Lead and develop the Product Led Growth analyst, setting a high bar for analytical quality, commercial impact and effective partnership with cross-functional teams.

What success looks like:

- A clear, prioritised Product Led Growth plan that delivers measurable progress against NSGMV, share of NSGMV and efficiency targets.

- An aligned Pricing & Discounting strategy with defined principles, priority opportunities and a sequenced roadmap covering both tutor and learner dynamics.

- High-potential Pricing & Discounting opportunities validated through robust business cases, proofs of concept or MVPs, creating confidence in where Preply should invest next.

- Demonstrable progress towards improving total lifetime value, margin and LTV to CAC efficiency through better pricing, discount and incentive decisions.

- Strong confidence and alignment across Growth, Product, Finance, Data and senior leadership, supported by concise communication and transparent trade-offs.

- A high-performing analyst with clear ownership, strong development and increasing impact on business and product decisions.

What you need to succeed:

- 8 or more years of relevant experience in growth strategy, commercial strategy, pricing, monetisation, business operations or a related role within a product-led technology business.

- Evidence of owning meaningful commercial KPIs for a growth area, business unit, channel or product, and of translating strategy into measurable business impact.

- Strong commercial judgement and a solid understanding of lifetime value, margin, unit economics and the trade-offs involved in growing a two-sided marketplace.

- Excellent strategic and critical thinking, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems, make clear choices and move effectively from analysis to execution.

- Experience working directly with Product, Engineering, Data and Finance teams to shape roadmaps, design experiments and deliver complex cross-functional initiatives.

- Strong analytical fluency and the ability to interrogate complex data, evaluate experiments and distinguish meaningful signals from noise. Hands-on SQL experience is helpful but not required.

- Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, including the ability to build alignment and communicate concise recommendations to senior leaders.

- Experience leading, coaching or developing analytical talent, with the ability to create clarity and raise the quality of a team's work.

- Practical fluency with AI tools, with evidence of using them to improve analysis, research, decision-making or operational workflows.

Experience that would be valuable:

- Direct experience in pricing, monetisation, promotions, discounts, incentives or marketplace economics.

- Experience in a consumer marketplace, subscription business, travel, e-commerce or another scaled digital product with complex pricing and lifetime value dynamics.

- A background that combines structured strategy or consulting experience with hands-on operating ownership.

Why you’ll love it at Preply:

- An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;

- A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com, Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development;

- A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;

- Not in Barcelona? We offer an attractive relocation package to join us in our Preply Barcelona Hub

- Access to free mental health support platforms;

- Access to Gympass-partnered wellness and gym centers throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health;

- The opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!).

Our Principles

- **Care to change the world** - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.

- **We do it for learners** - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.

- **Keep perfecting **- To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.

- **Now is the time** - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.

- **Disciplined execution** - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.

- **Dive deep** - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.

- **Growth mindset** - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.

- **Raise the bar** - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.

- **Challenge, disagree and commit** - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.

- **One Preply **- We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company. That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

**What You Will Bring**

- Deep familiarity with the CTV ecosystem, including streaming platform dynamics, publisher relationships, and measurement approaches, with the ability to evaluate inventory quality and targeting strategies.

Acorns is the financial wellness company helping everyday Americans grow their money for the long term. Since 2014, Acorns has grown into a global company with multiple life stage products serving the needs of kids, teens, adults, and parents. Rocket Money’s mission is to empower people to live their best financial lives. Rocket Money offers members a unique understanding of their finances and a suite of valuable services that save them time and money – ultimately giving them a leg up on their financial journey.

**ABOUT THE ROLE 🤹‍♀️**

Reporting to the Director of Growth, this role is responsible for executing Rocket Money's TV acquisition strategy across Linear and Streaming TV. You will own the day-to-day execution, analysis, and optimization of our TV media buying, turning strategy into results. You'll partner closely with the Director of Growth and cross-functional teams to sharpen measurement, test new tactics, and continuously improve performance. This is an opportunity to make an immediate, measurable impact on Rocket Money's growth. We are in a hyper-growth phase and expanding how we think about TV, from a performance-first engine toward a blended performance and brand strategy. In this role, you'll help accelerate velocity, unlock new scale, and raise the bar for how we approach growth marketing.

**IN THIS ROLE, YOU'LL:**

- **Drive TV Channel Performance:** Own day-to-day media buying, optimizations, pacing, and post-buy analysis across Linear and Streaming TV, ensuring we consistently hit CPA, CAC, and ROAS targets.

- **Optimize Spend For Efficiency and Impact:** Identify high-potential pockets, apply repeatable playbooks, and scale winning tactics across networks and publishers.

- **Analyze and Optimize Relentlessly:** Dive deep into campaign performance data to surface insights, identify winning networks, publishers, and formats, and translate learnings into actionable optimizations.

- **Design and Run Experiments:** Execute a structured testing roadmap for TV, developing clear hypotheses and success criteria for individual tests and translating results into actionable learnings.

- **Treat Creative As A Performance Lever:** Partner with the Creative team to brief, test, and iterate on TV creative, and turn testing insights into a stronger, higher-performing creative library.

- **Strengthen Measurement:** Collaborate with Data, Product, Engineering, and CRM to improve attribution, unlock growth levers, and ensure data quality across campaigns.

- **Communicate Performance and Insights:** Contribute to regular reporting on TV channel performance, sharing key wins, learnings, and recommendations with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

- **Improve Systems and Processes:** Contribute to Rocket Money's culture of curiosity by identifying opportunities to streamline workflows, enhance tracking, and build scalable processes as the TV program continues to grow.

- **Stay Ahead of the Space:** Track industry trends, identify first-to-market opportunities, and share learnings across the team.

- **Ensure Brand Safety and Compliance:** Uphold brand safety, regulatory compliance, and privacy standards in all media activity; collaborate with Legal/Compliance as needed.

**ABOUT YOU 🦄**

- 4+ years of experience in TV media buying at a high growth consumer company, startup, or agency, with hands-on experience across Linear and/or Streaming/CTV.

- Strong analytical foundation with fluency in core growth and efficiency metrics such as CAC, ROAS, LTV to CAC, and blended performance.

- Ability to turn data and experiment results into clear recommendations and action.

- Experience coordinating across internal teams and external partners or agencies.

- A holistic view of the marketing funnel and an understanding of the role each channel plays.

- Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and making fast decisions with imperfect information.

- Familiarity with TV measurement approaches like incrementality testing, media mix modeling, and attribution, and how to apply findings to channel strategy. Bonus points if you've worked with Haus.

- Naturally curious with a strong inclination to question assumptions and validate ideas through data and experimentation.

- Advanced proficiency in Excel. Experience with Looker or similar analytics tools is a plus.

title: Creative Producer

company.name: Wildlife Studios
company.blurb: One of the world's largest mobile game companies, behind Zooba and Tennis Clash.

description_md:
We are looking for a Creative Producer to join the Creative Strategy team at Wildlife. This is a role for someone who has spent their career making audiovisual work ,  writing, directing, producing ,  and who wants to apply that craft to advertising creative that runs at scale and is measured every day.

You will own the creative production pipeline for one or more of our games, working alongside Product Marketing Managers and our in-house Creative Studio team. You create and prioritize the ideas that get produced, and you stay close enough to production to make sure the idea survives execution.

You are accountable for the quality of the creative that goes out for the games under your scope, and for finding whatever you need to get there: pulling numbers, asking PMMs and Game Directors, studying what competitors are running, and using AI to move faster through research, benchmarking, and analysis.

What you'll do

You will generate creative concepts for the games under your scope and carry them from idea to script. You will work from competitor benchmarks, market and network trends across media channels, player signals, and performance results, and turn that material into a line of ideas the team can produce. We expect ideas that go further than the reference that inspired them.

You will write scripts and briefs that the Creative Studio and external providers can build from. You will direct production across video, playable, and static pieces, with a point of view on treatment, pacing, edit, and animation approach, reviewing cuts until the ad delivers what the idea promised. You will bring taste and creative judgment to the work, critiquing, refining, and holding the quality line.

You will read creative performance across metrics like Spend Share, IPM, CTR, CPI, ROAS, hook and hold rates, and use that read to decide what to iterate, what to scale, and what to abandon. You will follow test methodologies with PMMs and Data Scientists, and document learnings into the team's structured knowledge base, so insight compounds across creatives, games, and time.

What you'll need

- A senior track record in audiovisual production or creative direction ,  in a production company, an in-house studio, an agency, or as an independent director.

- A portfolio of work you directed or produced. This is the main input we will evaluate, and we will ask you to walk us through the decisions behind specific pieces.

- Scriptwriting as a practiced craft, from concept to shooting or animation script.

- Experience directing animation and motion work, enough to brief it, critique it, and correct it.

- Openness to go deep on performance marketing logic and metrics. Prior experience is welcome, and what we ask for is the willingness to learn it: digging into results, understanding why a creative won or lost, and using that to adjust the next round.

- Comfort with AI as part of daily workflow. You do not need to be technical, but you need to engage with AI tools as leverage.

- Excellent written and verbal communication, in English and Portuguese.

Nice to have

- Experience in mobile gaming or app marketing.

- Experience with playable ads, or with interactive formats.

- Familiarity with market intelligence tools (Sensor Tower, AppMagic, or similar) used to extract competitive insight.

- Experience running or reading structured A/B tests on creative.

More about you

- You have taste. You can tell good from great and you can articulate why.

- You generate ideas under pressure, in volume, without the quality dropping as the count goes up. Given a product, an audience, and a deadline, you can put a range of concepts on the table and defend the reasoning behind each one.

- You are curious about the market by default. You watch what works, you track competitors, you keep a running library of references without being asked.

- You are pragmatic about iteration. You do not get attached to your ideas. You get attached to learning.

title: Growth Marketing Manager, Conversion

company.name: Suno
company.blurb: AI music-creation app letting anyone make songs from a prompt.

description_md:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to **250 employees** while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a **$400 million Series D** at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About the Role

We're making our first CRO hire to own conversion at Suno, across web and the app stores. You'll sit on the Growth team at the point where our marketing spend turns into revenue: the landing pages, app store listings, funnels, and copy people hit after they click an ad, land from search, or find us in the App Store.

 

This is a performance job. You'll live in the numbers – conversion rate, install rate, CAC, revenue per visitor – and tie every test you run back to what it did for the business. You'll own the strategy and the copy, build pages and listings from our existing design system, and ship experiments at a pace that surprises people. You'll understand our ideal customer better than anyone in the building – who they are, what brings them to Suno, and what makes them convert ,  and shape every page, listing, and test around that.

 

You'll partner with User Acquisition, Lifecycle, Product, Engineering, and Data Science, and you'll work within our existing design system rather than in Figma yourself ,  grab a template, own the copy and the test, and ship. Conversion is yours to run. This is a senior IC role with real ownership and no team to manage. We want a hacker: someone scrappy and relentless who finds the fast path, ships more tests than anyone thinks is possible, and cares about learning fast and at scale more than about building the perfect system.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/vVeA30cOueLXfw8R

What You'll Do

- Understand our ideal customer more deeply than anyone else here, and turn that into pages, listings, copy, and tests that actually speak to them

- Ship a high volume of landing pages across paid, SEO, lifecycle, partnerships, and new launches, assembled from our existing design system and tailored to the channel and audience each serves

- Own app store optimization: the listing copy, screenshots, and store creative that turn store visits into installs, and the handoff into onboarding

- Localize and adapt pages and store listings for our international markets, so conversion holds up across languages and regions

- Write persuasive, on-brand copy and build pages from our existing design components, then test your way to better versions fast

- Run experiments at real volume: A/B and multivariate tests shipped quickly, using AI and whatever scrappy tooling gets you more shots on goal than the team could hit by hand

- Dig into user behavior with heatmaps, session recordings, surveys, and analytics to find where people drop off and why

- Hunt down the highest-leverage opportunities across the funnel by combining performance data, user research, and business context

- Own the conversion numbers end to end across web and app: conversion rate, install rate, CAC, and revenue per visitor, paid and organic

- Partner with Revenue Product on paywall and upsell copy, keeping it clear and true to what people are getting

- Push conversion testing to a volume and speed Suno hasn't seen, and pull the rest of the company along with what you learn

Qualifications

- You're a hacker. You move fast and ship a lot, and you've run a high volume of tests without a big team behind you

- 5-8 years in performance marketing, growth marketing, or CRO. You've owned conversion and funnel testing at scale, on the web and in the app stores (including ASO)

- You can write. You've written landing page copy that actually converted, and you know the customer well enough to know what to say to them

- You can read an experiment and know what it's telling you. We use Statsig internally, so you're comfortable pulling results, judging significance, and deciding what to do next

- You know the landing page toolkit. You've built and tested pages in tools like Optimizely, VWO, or Unbounce, and watched behavior in Clarity or Hotjar

- You set your own KPIs and run your own analysis. You can take user data and research and turn it into a test plan that ties back to the business

- You use AI to get more done than one person normally could

- You can tell a real win from a cheap trick, and you won't ship dark patterns. You work well with product and engineering and get changes live without slowing everyone down

Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US, and willing to work 5 days/week at our office in NYC or LA

Compensation

$160k - $185k base salary (before equity)

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

- Company Equity Package

- 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

- Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

- 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

- 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

- Creative Education Stipend

- Generous Commuter Allowance

- In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

title: Senior User Acquisition Manager (Web)

company.name: Flo Health
company.blurb: London-based women's health app, one of the most-installed health apps worldwide.

description_md:
**500M+ downloads. 80M+ monthly users. A decade of building – and we’re still accelerating.**

Flo is the world’s #1 health & fitness app worldwide on a mission to build a better future for female health. Backed by a $200M investment led by General Atlantic, we became the first product of our kind to reach a $1B valuation in 2024 – and we’re not slowing down.

With 7M paid subscribers and the highest-rated experience in the App Store’s health category, we’ve spent 10 years earning trust at scale. Now, we’re building the next generation of digital health – AI-powered, privacy-first, clinically backed – to help our users know their body better.

**The job**

- Plan, execute, and scale web user acquisition campaigns across Meta (Facebook/Instagram),  building a scalable UA engine

- Own your strategy and KPIs end-to-end: we provide the resources and the "why," you define the "how." No hand-holding, no micro-management ,  just results

- Monitor and optimize account structure, bidding models, and audience segmentation across platforms

- Lead creative testing frameworks ,  build and manage scalable systems for testing high volumes of creatives, identify what wins and why, and replicate success at scale

- Drive incremental growth through performance-focused strategy and rapid experimentation

- Own dynamic budget allocation to maximize ROAS

- Use AI tools and automation to streamline reporting, creative testing analysis, campaign optimization, and other recurring UA workflows

- Collaborate closely with analytics, creative, MarTech, and growth teams ,  guide creative focus, forecast asset delivery, and write clear technical requirements

- Dig into LTV, monetization, and web funnels; when a number moves, you're the first to ask why

- Generate insights from performance data, proactively surface opportunities, and produce regular performance reports and strategic recommendations

- Stay current on industry trends, platform updates, evolving privacy regulations, and emerging AI capabilities relevant to performance marketing

**Must Have**

- 5+ years of performance marketing experience in user acquisition, ideally in high-growth environments

- Expert-level experience managing campaigns across Meta Ads at scale, with hands-on experience in TikTok Ads and/or Snapchat Ads

- Proven track record managing significant monthly budgets and optimizing for ROAS, CPA, and LTV

- Solid understanding of web attribution principles and experience with tracking/analytics platforms

- Proficiency in BI tools (Looker, Tableau, PowerBI, or similar); comfortable pulling and analyzing data via SQL and/or advanced Excel or Google Sheets

- Practical experience using AI tools to automate or accelerate marketing workflows ,  reporting, creative analysis, campaign optimization, or process automation more broadly

- Strong communication and project management skills ,  able to sell ideas and negotiate priorities cross-functionally with stakeholders who don't report to you

- Comfortable with ambiguity: when the roadmap shifts or a problem has no clear playbook, you build the solution rather than wait for one

- Direct communicator who gives and welcomes honest feedback; willing to challenge a broken process or a wrong call

- You care about how UA affects LTV, product retention, and the business bottom line ,  business owner first, media buyer second

- Upper-intermediate or advanced English proficiency

- Ability to conduct market research and competitor analysis

- Experience in healthtech, wellness, or other strictly regulated verticals is a strong advantage

#LI-Hybrid

Salary Range - gross per month (ranges may vary based on skills and experience)

€4.800, €5.800 EUR

**How we work**

We’re a mission-led, product-driven team. We move fast, stay focused and take ownership – from brief to build to impact. Debate is encouraged. Decisions are shared. We care about craft, ship with purpose, and always raise the bar.

You’ll be working with people who take their work seriously, not themselves. It takes commitment, resilience, and the drive to keep going when things get tough. Because better health outcomes are worth it.

**What you'll get**

We support impact with meaningful reward. Here’s what that looks like:

- Competitive salary and annual reviews

- Opportunity to participate in Flo’s performance incentive scheme

- Paid holiday, sick leave, and female health leave

- Enhanced parental leave and pay for maternity, paternity, same-sex and adoptive parents

- Accelerated professional growth through world-changing work and learning support

- In-person collaboration and work in a hybrid model, with 3 days per week spent in the office

- 5-week fully paid sabbatical at 5-year Floversary

- Flo Premium for friends & family, plus more health, pension and wellbeing perks

**Diversity, equity and inclusion**

Our strength is in our differences. At Flo, hiring is based on merit, skill and what you bring to the role – nothing else. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds, communities and identities. Read our privacy notice for job applicants.

description_md:

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Paid Social Manager who is a true specialist in paid social performance marketing. You’ll manage our paid social campaigns end-to-end: platform partnerships, testing and measurement, driving web and app conversions at scale across markets.

This is a role for someone who has done this at real scale: you've managed paid social budgets of $30M+ annually, you understand attribution deeply, and you bring rigor, curiosity, and sharp analytical instincts to everything you touch. You should be comfortable digging into the data yourself ,  building your own analyses, spotting issues before anyone asks, and translating numbers into clear action. If that sounds like you, you'll fit right in.

You're also a builder, not just an operator. When a workflow is slow or a test framework doesn't exist yet, you build it rather than waiting for someone else to. You think like a creator: better tests, sharper creative, smarter systems. If that sounds like you, you'll fit right in.

We made a song about the role: https://suno.com/s/owdc28Zl5z3YqWbN

What You’ll Do

- **Own Paid Social channel performance globally: **manage campaigns optimizing for web and app conversions, subscriptions, and growth KPIs across multiple geographies and markets. Evaluate and pilot new platforms and formats as they become relevant.

- **Drive full-funnel results: **manage budgets, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, and creative testing to consistently hit CPA and ROAS targets at scale

- **Manage platform partnerships: **own the relationship with paid social channel reps, including beta access, product roadmap input, billing, and spend reconciliation.

- **Own analysis and reporting: **run proactive weekly performance analyses, using Excel and other tools to diagnose trends and surface opportunities. Design and run incrementality tests (geo holdouts, lift studies) to confirm spend is driving net new users, not just capturing demand that would have converted anyway.

- **Navigate app campaign complexity: **own tracking setup (Conversions API), MMP integration (Singular, AppsFlyer, Adjust, etc.), and mobile attribution nuance across platforms

- **Build your own tools: **when something is broken or needs improvement, build the fix yourself. Write the script, build the dashboard, design the smarter test framework. You do not wait for someone else to solve it, and you use your best judgement and expertise to make sure the analysis, strategy and execution drives excellent results.

- **Partner with creative & across the business: **own all creative analysis and give structured feedback on ad creative, brief new concepts, and drive iteration based on performance data. Work with lifecycle/CRM, product, data science, and finance to align on audience strategy, budget, and measurement.

- **Own budget and forecasting: **manage pacing across campaigns and markets, proactively reallocating spend to what’s working

- **Communicate with clarity: **translate complex campaign data into sharp insights and recommendations for cross-functional stakeholders

Qualifications

- 3+ years hands-on managing conversion-optimized paid social campaigns (must have specific paid social channel experience) with multi-million annual budget responsibility across major platforms

- Strong grasp of web conversion campaigns ,  pixels, events, landing page performance, and full-funnel optimization

- Experience running global campaigns across multiple geographies and markets

- Experience with app campaign mechanics and mobile attribution (MMPs like Singular, AppsFlyer, Adjust; SKAdNetwork, postbacks, etc.)

- Sharp analytical skills: advanced in Excel, including pivot tables, with a track record of proactively running weekly and ad hoc analyses to diagnose performance and drive decisions ,  not just reporting on results, but getting ahead of them

- Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where channels, tools, and strategy evolve constantly

- Nice to have: experience across a broad range of paid channels beyond the major social platforms (such as, X, Snapchat, Pinterest)

Additional Notes

- Must be eligible to work in the US.

- Must be willing to work 5 days/week in-office.

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

- Company Equity Package

- 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

- Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

- 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

- 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

- Creative Education Stipend

- Generous Commuter Allowance

- In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Compensation

The annual salary range for the target level for this role is $145,000 – $170,000 (before equity)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. description_md:
**ABOUT CODEWAY**

Codeway builds category-leading consumer AI apps on mobile and web, at global scale.

600M+ downloads. 60+ apps. 400+ builders across Barcelona and İstanbul. Completely bootstrapped. No board. Profitable since year two.

Small teams move faster than big ones. But they need big resources to win at scale. Nobody starts from zero. The problem decides the solution, not us.

We turn category wins into six focused vertical companies: Wishlabs (AI Creativity), Wellture (Wellness), Learna (Education), Sparked (Media), Cosmic Jam (Entertainment), and Catalyst Apps (Utilities & Productivity). Each has full ownership and the depth to go further than anyone else in its space.

Codeway HQ powers them all. One platform. One team that finds and grows builders. One set of guardrails. Every idea born here starts with an unfair advantage: the platform, the people, and the profits of every product before it. That's the system.

Turns out you can do both.

Move like an indie. Hit like a giant.

**
POSITION**

We know that a Associate Marketing Artist is the backbone of a successful marketing campaign. We have the best products and the strongest analytical capabilities in our category. And with you, we’ll have everything we need to scale our success.

That’s why we are looking for a creative and exceptional Associate Marketing Artist who will help us introduce our apps to millions of users around the world.

**
WHAT YOU'LL DO**

- **Craft compelling designs.** Craft visually compelling designs for mobile product-related marketing campaigns, including both motion graphics and static visuals.

- **Collaborate with marketing.** Work closely with the Marketing Team to understand data insights and brainstorm innovative creative ad ideas.

- **Translate initiatives into visuals.** Transform key marketing initiatives into high-quality, consumer-facing visuals that capture attention.

- **Follow trends.** Stay on top of social media trends and the mobile app creative ad industry.

- **Analyze performance.** Analyze performance data from creatives, break down ad performance, and generate improvement ideas.

- **Manage external communication.** Communicate with and brief third-party vendors on visual creation needs, ensuring smooth production processes.

- **Create 2D assets.** Assist in creating eye-catching 2D assets for UA ads and static content.

- **Optimize assets.** Adjust existing assets for different formats and specifications such as resizing, re-layouts, and localizations.

- **Use design tools.** Work with Adobe After Effects, Photoshop, Figma, Illustrator, and Premiere Pro to deliver high-quality outputs.

- **Support motion design.** Contribute to motion graphics production with a strong interest in animation and visual storytelling.

**
WHAT YOU'LL BRING**

- **Passion.** Passion for marketing, product, AI or data-driven creativity. Simple enough.

- **Know-how.** You have a technical background or experience in relevant fields.

- **Analytical approach.** You're a fast learner who can independently explore and grasp new concepts. You can solve unexpected problems with your creativity.

- **Data-driven creativity.** Leveraging insights from various data sets to develop creatives aligned with audience preferences and test results.

- **Out of the box thinking.** You’re able to gather and combine inspiration into strong creative ideas while bringing new perspectives.

- **Good communication.** Crystal clear communication skills.

- **Proficiency in English.** You read, write, and speak without any trouble in English.

- **Cool vibe.** You’re open to constructive criticism and feedback. You’re ready to improve yourself accordingly.

- **Take the wheel.** You’re hands-on, driven, and focused on achieving results with persistence and ownership.

- **Ownership.** We want you to be ready to own every aspect of your project. You won’t be a newcomer here; you’ll own your thing.

 

**WHAT WE OFFER**

· **Great Place to Work.** As our top team member, you'll be a part of a fast-growing startup and have the privilege to enjoy our accredited “BEST WORKPLACES” environment, ranked first among all workplaces.

· **A Competitive Compensation Package.** Long story short, we take care of you.

· **A Meal Compensation.** That is actually enough for a decent & nutritious lunch, we’re not following the industry standard.

· **Full Health Benefits.** To keep you away from all the trouble, we provide unlimited private health insurance and cover the HPV vaccine.

· **Pet Adoption Support.** We cover the primary healthcare expenses, parasite vaccinations, and microchip costs that may arise within the first year after employees adopt a pet.

· **Cool Tech Stack.** Macbook, iPhone 15 Pro, magic mouse, magic keyboard; an adjustable desk with a 4K screen and any other gadget you may need in your job.

· **Sport Activities Support.** We care about your physical wellbeing and support your gym membership.

· **Learning Never Ends!** Training budget to help you grow in your role, gain new skills, and learn new things.

· **Udemy Free Pass.** An unlimited Udemy subscription.

· **Flexible Schedule & Unlimited Vacations.** This isn’t a “clock in, clock out” company. We care about your productivity, not tracking every minute you’re on site. It’s up to you to always be responsible with your work, no matter where you are or what schedule you’re keeping.

· **English Course Support.** Be more global and perform best at your work.

· **Comprehensive Well-being Support.** Through our partnership with Meditopia, we now offer free psychological counseling, along with additional services like dietitian, personal trainer, parenting consultant, physiotherapist, child & adolescent therapist, and face-to-face counseling for employees in Istanbul.

· **A Top-Notch Office.** Located at the heart of Istanbul, right next to Levent Metro Station at Ferko Signature.

· **Codebrew.** Yes, you’ve heard it right: We love coffee so much that we’ve built our own coffee shop inside our office, where we also provide healthy snacks at certain hours.

· **Free Breakfast.** At Codebrew - every morning at 9:30 AM.

· **No Dress Code.** Dress as you like.

· **Happy Hours Every Friday.** Every. Single. Friday. When it’s 5 PM: Screens off, party on! (Check out Codeway on Instagram)

· **Dream Team.** Average Codeway member is young, talented, and passionate - which makes our working environment extremely dynamic. Need proof? Take a look at our Instagram.

· **Gaming Area.** Whenever you need to take a break from hard work and relax with your favorite games, our PS5 corner will be waiting for you.

· **Software Support.** Subscription to any software you might need to perform at your best.

title: Paid Social Creative Strategist (Contract)

company.name: Suno
company.blurb: AI music-creation app letting anyone make songs from a prompt.

description_md:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to **200 employees** while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a **$400 million Series D** at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About the Role

Suno’s growth runs on paid social, and paid social runs on creative. This is the role that decides what that creative is and why: the strategist who turns audience insight into the concepts everyone else executes. You’ll lead the audience and market research that uncovers new angles, pain points, and use cases, then turn them into a steady backlog of concepts and briefs that designers and editors run with across Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok.

This is a high-ownership role with real strategic latitude. You won’t be handed a brief and told to fill it, you’ll write the briefs. You’ll bring your own read on which audiences are worth chasing, what story wins them, and which formats to test, then move fast to test, iterate, and find what wins. Great work here is measured by performance, and you’ll see the results of your concepts quickly enough to act on them.

If you think in audiences and angles, read hook rate and hold rate as fluently as you spot a fresh one, and want your concepts running in front of a massive global audience within days, this one is for you.

What You’ll Do

- Lead deep audience and market research to uncover new personas, pain points, and use cases worth targeting.

- Turn that research into a steady backlog of net-new ad concepts, each with a clear rationale for why it should win.

- Write sharp creative briefs that give designers, editors, and producers a clear direction to execute against.

- Develop angles, hooks, and messaging built around how people actually behave on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok.

- Define what to test next and why, isolating variables so every result teaches us something.

- Keep a deep bench of fresh ideas in flight to stay ahead of creative fatigue, so no single winner carries the account too long.

- Partner with performance marketing managers to turn account needs into concrete creative direction.

- Read performance signals and feed them back into sharper concepts, as bandwidth allows.

What You’ll Need

**Must-Haves**

- Proven experience as a creative strategist in a high-volume, high-velocity performance creative environment.

- A strong track record of paid social creative for live Meta and/or TikTok campaigns, with results you can speak to.

- A real grasp of direct-response creative: audiences, angles, hooks, and why an ad wins or loses, not just how it looks.

- Deep fluency in audience and market research, and the instinct to turn it into non-obvious angles.

- The range to own strategy end to end and the scrappiness to write the hooks and do the research yourself. No task is beneath you.

- A proactive, self-directed working style. You spot what’s missing and bring ideas without being asked.

- Fluency in Motion (or a comparable creative analytics tool) to read what’s driving performance and act on it.

- Comfort reading metrics such as hook rate, hold rate, and CTR, and turning them into the next round of concepts.

**Nice-to-Haves**

- Experience at a consumer subscription app, a growth agency running paid social, or a DTC/ecommerce brand.

- Comfort folding AI tools into research and ideation to move faster.

- A love of music and an eye for culture.

**Compensation**

This is a contract role paying $80 to $120 per hour, depending on experience, at roughly 20 to 40 hours per week.

**Additional Notes**

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

description_md:
Creative Strategy Intern ,  Wildlife

We are looking for a Creative Strategy Intern to join the Creative Strategy team at Wildlife. This is a role for someone at the start of their career who is curious about markets, excited by data, and wants to learn how strategic reads turn into creative decisions that drive performance at scale.

You will support the creative strategy for one or more of our games, working closely with experienced Creative Strategists, Product Marketing Managers, and our in-house Studio team. You will learn how we decide what gets produced, why, for whom, and how we measure if it worked ,  and you will contribute to that process from day one.

The team operates on a core conviction: AI is now a method of work, not a tool on the side. We are structuring data, briefing, ideation, and analytics to run with AI as substrate. You will learn to use AI to multiply your output, feed structured signal into the system, and start building the judgment to curate what comes out.

What you'll do

- You will help maintain a continuous read of competitors, market trends, and network behavior across TikTok, Meta, and others, learning to turn that read into inputs for briefs and decisions. You will get hands-on with intelligence tools like Sensor Tower and internal data to understand what we test, scale, and abandon.

- You will support the team in authoring briefs, learning the craft of briefing: the highest-leverage moment of the creative cycle. You will follow the production handoff with the Studio team and start developing the taste and judgment to tell good work from great.

- You will help read creative performance across metrics like Spend Share, IPM, CTR, CPI, ROAS, hook and hold rates, learning to spot patterns and translate them into the next round of bets. You will help document learnings into the team's structured knowledge base so insight compounds over time.

What you'll need

- Mandatory: Expected graduation between July 2027 and December 2027. Applications outside this window will not be considered.

- Genuine curiosity about markets, consumer behavior, and what makes creative work.

- Comfort working with data and a willingness to dig into metrics and spreadsheets to find the story.

- Comfort with AI as part of your daily workflow ,  you don't need to be technical, but you should treat AI tools as leverage, not curiosity.

- Strong written and verbal communication, in English and Portuguese.

- No prior professional experience required ,  we care about how you think and how fast you learn.

Nice to have

- Personal projects, coursework, or internships involving marketing, data analysis, or content/creative.

- Interest in mobile gaming, app marketing, or consumer products operating at scale.

- Any exposure to A/B testing, motion design, video, or playable ads.

More about you

- You are curious about the market by default. You notice what works, you have opinions about ads, and you like understanding why.

- You are developing taste and want to sharpen it. You're starting to tell good from great and you want to learn to articulate why.

- You like connecting the dots between a spreadsheet, a brief, and a conversation about the game.

- You are pragmatic about iteration. You don't get attached to your ideas ,  you get attached to learning.

- You write clearly and communicate with precision. People leave conversations with you knowing what you mean.

- You stay curious and calm in a fast-moving environment where the plan changes often.

title: Playable Ads Strategist

description_md:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

Voodoo’s Growth team is responsible for turning our games into successful products, combining user acquisition, creative, monetization, and data.

Within Growth, the **Playable Ads team** turns our games into short, interactive experiences designed to make players stop, play, and want more. Working closely with playable developers and creative teams, we design, produce, test, and iterate on playable ads across our 20+ game portfolio.

Role

Your goal will be to make someone stop-scrolling, understand a game, enjoy playing it, and want to discover more: all within a few seconds. You’ll coordinate creative production with internal and external teams, improve performance, and drive innovation.

**Managing your own portfolio of games, you will:**

- Deconstruct games into their most engaging moments: understand core loops, player motivations, difficulty curves and “aha” moments, then identify what can be turned into a compelling playable ad.

- Design playable concepts from scratch: come up with interactive experiences that capture the essence of a game in seconds, balancing gameplay depth, accessibility, pacing and curiosity.

- Think like both a game designer and a growth strategist: make creative decisions with a clear hypothesis around player behavior, then use performance data to understand what actually drives engagement.

- Write sharp gameplay briefs: translate ideas into clear mechanics, flows, difficulty progressions and player journeys that developers and production partners can execute.

- Work closely with developers and creative teams: guide production from the first concept to the final playable, making sure the gameplay feels intuitive, satisfying and true to the original game.

- Iterate relentlessly: analyze performance, identify where players drop off or engage, and turn those learnings into the next, better version.

Profile

We’re open to different backgrounds. What matters most is your **ability to understand what makes a game engaging, turn insights into strong creative concepts, and drive them through production.**

- You have a strong understanding of gameplay, player behavior, creative strategy, or growth, and know how to turn insights into actionable ideas.

- You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to benchmark markets, identify trends, formulate hypotheses, and turn them into creative strategies.

- You have excellent project management skills and can turn ideas into clear briefs, align internal and external stakeholders, and drive projects from concept to execution.

- You have a sharp creative eye and can articulate why a concept, mechanic, or design choice works (or doesn’t).

- You have a strong interest in mobile games and apps, and enjoy understanding what makes players engage within seconds.

- You’re entrepreneurial, autonomous, and comfortable in a fast-paced environment, with a strong bias towards testing, learning, and iterating.

- Hands-on experience with AI creative tools (Scenario, Seedance, Kling, Veo, Runway, etc.) is a plus.

- Experience with playable ads, game production, or third-party creative partners is a plus.

- You are fluent in English.

Benefits

- Competitive salary and other benefits according to the country you reside in.

Full remote for candidates based abroad, with relocation to Paris subject to discussion. Hybrid for candidates based in France.
