title: Gameplay Capture & Video Artist, Creative Studio

company.name: Supercell
company.blurb: Helsinki studio behind Clash of Clans, Clash Royale and Brawl Stars.

description_md:
**From explosive action to cozy casual, join us to make it all look as good as it plays.**

Supercell makes games for as many people as possible – games that are played for years and remembered forever. The Creative Studio's job is to make sure the world sees them at their best. We're looking for a versatile Gameplay Capture & Video Artist to do exactly that across our portfolio, from fast, action-driven titles to midcore and casual experiences.

You'll be the person who knows how to make any game look its best on camera – capturing the moments that stop a scroll and drive installs across Meta, TikTok, YouTube and beyond, then turning that raw material into performance creative at the volume and speed UA demands.

This is a UA-first craft role, and it's built on trust. Supercell runs on small, independent teams and very little process – which means you'll own your work end to end, set your own bar for quality, and be trusted to make the calls on how to hit it. We're not looking for someone who waits to be told what to do. We're looking for someone who treats this craft like it's their own studio: proactive, self-driven, and relentless about reaching a higher bar than anyone asked for.

If you love games, understand what makes an ad convert, and want real ownership over your work, this is for you.

 

**What You'll Be Doing**

- Capture high-quality gameplay footage and stills across a range of Supercell titles and genres (action, midcore, casual), with the instinct to surface the most compelling, install-driving moments in each.

- Own the production of UA creative at volume – turning raw capture into testable ad variants optimized for performance across Meta, TikTok, YouTube and other paid channels.

- Build AI-assisted creative tools (e.g. Scenario, Higgsfield) into your everyday workflow, feeding clean capture into AI generation and iteration to scale output and explore concepts faster.

- Capture across multiple devices and platforms (iOS, Android, PC) to a consistently high technical standard.

- Edit and enhance footage with sound, transitions, effects and pacing tuned for short-form, performance-driven formats.

- Work iteratively with UA – reading creative performance signals and rapidly producing new variants and concepts in response.

- Collaborate directly across cells – UA, marketing, brand and game teams – with minimal bureaucracy, taking your work where it has the most impact even when that's outside the strict scope of the role.

- Optimize and version content for different placements, formats and aspect ratios, so every asset fits the channel and the test.

**What You Have**

- Proven experience in gameplay capture and video editing for performance/UA creative, with a portfolio that shows both craft and an understanding of what drives results.

- A self-set high bar – demonstrable evidence (work-related or not) of pushing your craft further than required, without anyone telling you to.

- Demonstrated ability to capture polished footage across multiple games, genres and devices.

- Expert proficiency with capture and editing tools – OBS Studio and Adobe Creative Suite (After Effects, Premiere, Media Encoder).

- Hands-on experience (or strong, demonstrable aptitude) with AI-assisted creative tools, and a genuine drive to build them into a production workflow.

- A strong feel for gameplay across genres, and an instinct for the moments that resonate with different player audiences.

- Proven ability to produce high-quality creative quickly and at volume under tight, iterative deadlines.

- A collaborative, data-aware mindset and the maturity to "disagree and commit" – push your point of view hard, then get fully behind the decision.

- Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to own multiple titles and projects in parallel with little oversight.

**Would Be Nice if You Also Have**

- Strong motion design, graphic design or animation skills.

- Affinity for digital trends and memes, and the ability to apply them seamlessly into creative.

- Experience with Unreal Engine for gameplay capture, camera work or visual effects.

- Experience in a high-volume creative testing environment (in-house UA team or performance-focused agency)

**Where You'll Be**

This role will be based in our Helsinki office.

–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read.

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page.

–––

**About Supercell **

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

**Hey, You Might Love It Here!**

Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.

**You Are Not Your Job Title ™**

Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

**Benefits and Compensation **

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.

**Relocation? Yes!**

No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!

**Not Sure if You Should Apply? **

Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

title: Creative Strategist

company.name: Voodoo
company.blurb: Paris-based mobile games and apps publisher, one of the largest hypercasual and hybrid-casual UA operations in the world.

description_md:
**About Voodoo**

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

 

Team

Our Growth team maximizes the potential of every Voodoo product through a mix of user acquisition, ad monetization, video and playable ads, and influencer marketing. We combine operational excellence with creative thinking to constantly adapt, innovate, and stay ahead of the market.

 

Role

We are looking for a Creative Strategist to shape the ad strategy behind our portfolio of games and apps. You’ll spot market trends, uncover what drives performance, and turn insights into actionable creative briefs. Working closely with UA, Marketing Artists, Developers, Product teams, and Growth leaders, you’ll drive creative decisions that turn bold ideas into high-performing ads and help our products become global hits.

Responsibilities

Your goal will be to understand what makes a game stand out, spot what drives ad performance, and turn those insights into creative strategies that fuel growth. You’ll combine market intelligence, performance data, and creative thinking to help our games capture attention and win players.

**Managing your own portfolio of games, you will:**

- **Define the creative strategy for your games:** understand each game's core mechanics, audience, growth priorities, and competitive landscape to identify the strongest creative opportunities.

- **Spot what makes ads work:** deconstruct top-performing creatives to uncover winning hooks, gameplay mechanics, storytelling patterns, and trends worth exploring.

- **Turn insights into creative direction:** translate benchmarking, market intelligence, and performance data into sharp, actionable briefs that inspire new concepts and guide execution.

- **Think like both a strategist and a creative:** build hypotheses around what will capture attention and drive results, then use performance data to validate your ideas and refine your approach.

- **Work closely with UA and creative teams:** collaborate with Marketing Artists and Developers to turn insights into compelling ads, while aligning with Product teams and Growth leaders on game priorities.

- **Benchmark relentlessly:** use internal tools and platforms such as MarketIQ, Apptica, and Data.ai to track competitors, anticipate emerging trends, and uncover new opportunities across genres.

- **Turn learnings into action:** analyze creative performance, share insights across teams, and scale winning approaches across our game portfolio.

- **Push creative performance further:** identify opportunities to improve workflows, creative output, and team capabilities to keep Voodoo ahead of the market.

Profile

- Experience in creative strategy, growth marketing, strategy consulting, or a similar role.

- Strong understanding of mobile games, player behavior, and performance-driven advertising.

- Ability to combine market intelligence, competitor benchmarking, and performance data to shape creative strategies and identify growth opportunities.

- Strong analytical and ideation skills, with the ability to turn insights into compelling concepts and actionable creative briefs.

- Proficiency in analytics and benchmarking tools; hands-on experience with AI creative tools (Scenario, Seedance, Kling, Veo, Runway, etc.).

- Excellent communication skills (full english proficiency, french is a strong plus) and ability to collaborate across UA, Creative, and Product teams.

- Proactive, adaptable, and eager to challenge existing approaches, experiment, and iterate.

- You thrive in an environment that values candor, freedom, and responsibility.

Benefits (France)

- Competitive salary based on experience

- Swile Lunch voucher

- Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)

- Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family

- Wellness activities in our Paris office

 

Full remote for candidates based abroad (benefits according to the country you reside in), with relocation to Paris subject to discussion. Hybrid for candidates based in France.

title: Associate Team Lead Growth

company.name: Homa
company.blurb: Mobile games publisher (hyper/hybrid-casual).

description_md:
Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world's best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor.

Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.

At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

**Mission**

As a Associate Team Lead Growth, you’ll play a key role in driving the performance of Homa’s live mobile game portfolio. You will own the execution of game-level growth strategies, manage a team of junior Growth Specialists, and operate at the intersection of UA, monetization, and product ,  using data, AI, and creative thinking to unlock scale on games that millions of players enjoy.

Your main responsibilities will include:

- **Own live portfolio growth** ,  execute the growth strategy for assigned live games, drive ROI improvement through AB testing, ad network optimization, and data-informed iteration
- **Lead a team** ,  manage 2–3 junior Growth Specialists, set clear expectations, develop their skills, and hold them accountable to outcomes
- **Drive cross-team execution** ,  collaborate closely with Monetization and Product teams to align on priorities, launch the right tests, and turn insights into game improvements
- **Activate the right ad networks** ,  identify and prioritize ad network models that fit each game’s stage and KPIs, executing with speed to capture scale opportunities
- **Build smarter with AI** ,  use AI tools every day to analyze data across games, automate processes, and continuously find new ways to operate with more leverage

This is a great opportunity to rebuild a growth team from the ground up, own a real portfolio with full autonomy, and make outsized impact fast in one of Europe’s most ambitious mobile gaming companies.

**Requirements**

We are looking for someone with around 3 years of experience in growth, UA, or performance marketing ,  and the humility, curiosity, ambition, and drive to make an impact fast. You’re a great fit if you have:

- **Proven cross-team collaboration skills** ,  you’ve worked with Product, Monet, or Data teams and driven real joint outcomes without being managed
- **Strong data analysis ability** ,  you read performance metrics fluently, identify opportunities others miss, and make confident decisions
- **An AI-native mindset** ,  you actively use AI tools to get more done, build smarter processes, and explore new approaches daily
- **A creative, outside-the-box approach to growth** ,  you think beyond campaign management and bring fresh angles to performance challenges
- **The ability to lead people** ,  you set clear expectations, give direct feedback, and push a team toward results without micromanaging

Bonus points if you have:

- Experience managing a small team or mentoring junior team members
- Hands-on exposure to offerwall networks, gaming SDK monetization, or live game AB testing
- Background in ad creatives or social trend spotting
- Experience building automations or tools using AI (e.g. MCP-based workflows, cross-game data analysis)

Even if you don’t check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we’re more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

**Our Culture**

At Homa, we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, act with pragmatism, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

- **Humility:** We recognise that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow - we stay grounded in a clear view of ourselves.
- **Curiosity:** We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what” - we explore with purpose and practicality.
- **Focus:** Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider - we obsess over the details and let pragmatism guide our attention.
- **Ambition:** We strive for the best - we don’t settle for “good enough,” - we use common sense to reach higher.

**Benefits**

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here’s what you can expect:

- **🏥 Comprehensive Benefits:** Depending on your location, you’ll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.
- **🏢 Paris HQ Access:** Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.
- **🌍 Coworking Access:** You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.
- **🌐 Global Team:** Collaborate in English with top-tier talent from 35+ countries, spanning Europe, the UK, the US, and more.
- **✈️ Team Gatherings:** Join us for occasional team gatherings and off-site retreats (Workations) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.
- **📈 Performance Reviews:** Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize achievements, and align on development goals.
- **💻 Equipment Support:** From day one, we’ll provide everything you need, including a home office setup allowance if working remotely.

**Where We Hire**

Our HQ in Paris is a vibrant hub of creativity, collaboration, and connection. From rooftop lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, we’ve designed a space people genuinely enjoy - all within a cosy WeWork filled with good energy (and snacks).

We also have incredible team members across Europe - from Spain and Turkey to Germany, North Macedonia, Poland, the UK, and more. Whether you’re working from a sunny WeWork in Barcelona or your home setup in Warsaw, you’re fully part of our culture. To keep collaboration smooth, we primarily hire within European time zones (UTC to UTC+3). If you’re based there - or planning to be - we’d love to hear from you!

title: Growth Marketing Manager, ASO (Contract)

company.name: Kabam
company.blurb: Vancouver mobile games studio behind Marvel Contest of Champions.

description_md:
At Kabam, we’re constantly raising the bar of excellence in free-to-play gaming. We hire for passion and diversity so that we can triumph in our collective skill. Our teams are made up of a fusion of personalities and interests bound together by a collaborative nature, fun-loving culture, and a drive to do what it takes to make great games. And this is where you come in...

Reporting to the Senior Growth Marketing Manager, the **Growth Marketing Manager, ASO (Contract)** will unify ASO strategy and execution into a single point of contact to ensure streamlined strategy and execution. This role is critical for driving organic growth for live service titles like MCoC and Shop Titans, while leading the Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy for upcoming new title launches.

**In this role, you can expect to:**

ASO Strategy & Execution

- Roadmap Management: Develop the ASO roadmap, balancing default page optimizations with a robust A/B testing schedule of 3–5 tests per month per game.

- Semantic Optimization: Develop strategy and execution to align with ongoing platform changes driven by AI.

- AI-Driven Workflows: Utilize generative AI tools to scale high-volume metadata creation, localize for target markets, and perform sentiment analysis on competitor reviews.

- Storefront Operations: Lead end-to-end execution across iOS, Google Play, Epic, and Steam, including uploading assets and managing storefront asset sheets.

- Creative & Keyword Optimization: Collaborate with Creative Services (CS) to brief and iterate on high-impact assets like icons, screenshots, and feature graphics.

- Launch Readiness (New Title): Lead ASO requirements for new game preparation, including soft launch testing roadmaps and post-launch optimization.

- QA & Compliance: Review all store pages before submission and act as the final sign-off for the PRM release gate.
Technical & Social Health: Monitor app store trends, competitor strategies, and algorithm changes to maintain visibility rankings.

Platform Marketing & Event Cards

- Strategy Consulting: Advise on platform best practices for App Event Cards across the portfolio to optimize performance, partnering closely with PMM and Creative Services (CS).

- Execution: Support Product Marketing in areas that are needed such as (but not limited to) execution, including copywriting, creative ideation/project management, etc.

- Cross-Functional: If necessary, coordinate with PMM, PRM, CS, and BD to align ASO efforts with game calendars and platforms featuring opportunities.

- Maintenance: Maintain the Platform Event Card Mastersheet and track performance metrics.

Analysis, Reporting & Synergy

- Holistic Reporting: Monitor ASO KPIs (Impressions, Page Views, Downloads, CVR) and provide weekly/quarterly recaps.

- Stakeholder Reporting: Deliver weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance recaps to cross-functional stakeholders.

- Market Intelligence: Conduct thorough keyword research and competitor analysis to identify high-impact optimization opportunities.

- Growth Modeling: Partner with Data Science to build forecasting models and evaluate the business impact of storefront optimizations.

- Behavioral Analysis: Track post-install engagement and retention signals, as the 2026 algorithm increasingly rewards sustained user value over simple download velocity.

- Industry trends: Share ongoing trend updates that are impacting our organic installs and store presence to major stakeholders. Ensure to provide up to date information in real time and insights on how this can impact Kabam’s business.

**To be successful in this role, your background includes:**

- Experience: 2+ years in Growth Marketing and ASO within the mobile gaming industry.

- Platform Expertise: Deep knowledge of modern app store algorithms, including Apple's NLP intent matching and Google’s AI-organized "Guided Search".

- AI Tooling: Proficiency in AI-specific ASO tools (e.g., AppTweak) and LLMs for workflow efficiency.

- Analytical Skills: Strong data-driven mindset with the ability to build growth models and forecast install impact.

- Project Management: Ability to manage high-volume storefront setups (iOS, Google Play, Epic, Steam) and track all changes meticulously.

title: Social Media Manager, Growth Marketing

company.name: AppLovin
company.blurb: Mobile app growth and monetisation platform with its own portfolio of apps and games.

description_md:
About AppLovin

AppLovin makes technologies that help businesses of every size connect to their ideal customers. The company provides end-to-end advertising solutions for businesses to reach, monetize and grow their global audiences. For more information about AppLovin, visit: www.applovin.com.

To deliver on this mission, our global team is composed of team members with life experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives that mirror our developers and customers around the world. At AppLovin, we are intentional about the team and culture we are building, seeking candidates who are outstanding in their own right and also demonstrate their support of others.

About the role

AppLovin is one of the largest and fastest-growing ad platforms in the world. Brands of all sizes use AppLovin to grow their businesses - from small ecommerce brands rapidly growing by tens of millions in revenue annually, to large companies that do billions in revenue. Most consumer brands just haven't discovered AppLovin yet, or don't understand how it can transform their business. Your job is to drive advertisers to AppLovin through our social accounts.

Most B2B social content falls flat. Videos don’t get watched. Threads get scrolled past. We want a storyteller with taste and a point of view. AI tools are leveraged to move faster, but the ideas, the calls, and the craft are yours. You experiment, kill what does not work, and double down on what does, regardless of format.

What you'll do

- **Run our social accounts.** Own X, LinkedIn, YouTube, and Instagram day to day - what goes out, when, and why.

- **Figure out what content lands and ship it.** Charts, threads, videos, webinars, livestreams, whatever wins. Pull from our first-party advertiser data, customer voices, new product features, and the broader market.

- **Engage, don’t just broadcast.** Jump into the conversations where brands and builders already are. The accounts should feel alive, not scheduled.

- **Ship fresh content weekly.** Measure performance and home in on what lands and stop doing what doesn’t.

- **Find ways to amplify content** such as partnering with influencers and brands.

What we're looking for

- **You have built something that went viral.** A tweet that broke 10M views, a podcast that hit, a video that broke 1M, a Substack that scaled past 10k subs. You are a storyteller first.

- **You can build from scratch on your own**, and you also know how to partner with designers and video teams when something deserves a bigger swing.

- **You are extremely online and obsessed with what builders are shipping right now. **AI agents, indie tools, viral consumer apps, breakout DTC brands. You know who is making them, why they are working, and why their posts are blowing up.

- (BONUS): You are fluent in Claude Code and agentic AI tools. You build things with them ,  sites, tools, workflows, content. Not just chat with them.

AppLovin provides a competitive total compensation package with a pay for performance rewards approach. $170,000, $243,000 USD

title: Monetization Specialist

company.name: Huuuge Games

description_md:

At Huuuge Games, we make top-grossing mobile games that bring people together through fun and social mobile gaming.
